name: RadhaKrishn
description: The story of Radha and Krishna is the epitome of eternal love, which transcends eras and emotions.

credits_cast.character: Parvati / Sati / Siddhidatri / Durga / Mahakali / Bhadrakali
credits_cast.name: Piyali Munsi

videos.title: The Classic Love Saga
videos.overview: Witness the eternal love story of Radha Krishna. Lord Krishna's ardent devotee, Sridhama curses Radha and separates her from Krishna. How will they unite now?

videos.title: Radha, Krishna Take a New Birth
videos.overview: Radha takes birth in the Rawal village, Brijbhumi as Vrishbhan's daughter. Vrishbhan sees his daughter but is shocked to find that her eyes are still closed. Meanwhile, Devaki gives birth to Krishna within the confinements of Kansa's prison.

videos.title: Vasudev Swaps the Infants
videos.overview: Time stands still as Vasudev visits Nanda's house and exchanges the infants. On the other hand, Radha's parents celebrate her birth.

videos.title: Krishna Kills a Demon
videos.overview: Krishna kills a demon. Krishna and Radhey grow into young adults and yearn to meet each other again.

videos.title: Radha's Stern Decision
videos.overview: Kansa punishes the potter for obstructing his yagya. Krishna sets out to meet Radha, who is determined to defy Kansa and help the poor potters.

videos.title: It's Time for Love, Again!
videos.overview: Lord Krishna falls in love once again, when he comes across Radha selling earthen pots. On the other hand, Radha feels mystical when he helps her.

videos.title: Radha Appreciates Lord Krishna
videos.overview: Lord Krishna does something unexpected and wins Radha's appreciation. Later, Radha gets into trouble.

videos.title: Krishna Is Radha's Saviour
videos.overview: Krishna rescues Radha from the soldiers. He brings Kansa's soldiers to task for trying to arrest him. Kansa is determined to destroy Krishna.

videos.title: Krishna Grabs Radha's Attention
videos.overview: Krishna wins the confidence of Radha's parents and comes up with a way to grab her attention. Kansa tells Devaki that he has tracked her son's whereabouts.

videos.title: Will Krishna Oblige Radha?
videos.overview: Radha forces Krishna to reveal the identity of his beloved when he tells that he loves a girl from her hamlet. Kansa plans his strategy against Krishna.

videos.title: Krishna's Smart Idea
videos.overview: Radhey feels frantic as she wakes up from a nightmare. Krishna comes up with a clever plan to protect Gokul and the villagers from the demon.

videos.title: Radha's Concern for Krishna
videos.overview: Krishna convinces Nanda Baba and the others to stay at Barsana. Krishna teases Radha, seeing her overwhelming care for him.

videos.title: Ayan Confronts Krishna
videos.overview: Kans tells Devaki and Vasudev that he had killed Krishna. Elsewhere, Ayan confronts Krishna about his intentions, but ends up receiving a stern punishment.

videos.title: Krishna wants Radha's Room
videos.overview: Ayan wants to avenge Krishna. Radha confronts Krishna, seeing him in her room and asks him to leave. But, he is reluctant to do so.

videos.title: Radha Feels Mystical
videos.overview: Radha feels nostalgic as she looks into Krishna's eyes. Ayan expresses his love for Radha and warns Krishna to stay away.

videos.title: Jhatila Is against Krishna
videos.overview: Krishna and Ayan don't tell Radha about their challenge. Jhatila persuades Kirtida against getting Krishna married to Radha and instigates Ayan against Krishna.

videos.title: Krishna Makes a Demand
videos.overview: Balram bashes up Ayan and his friends after he insults him. Krishna tells Radha to fulfill his demand if she wants him to stop Balram.

videos.title: Radha Feeds Krishna
videos.overview: Krishna is delighted as Radha accepts his friendship and feeds butter to him. Later, Ayan and his men visit Balram and try to attack him. Will Krishna be able to stop the fight?

videos.title: Radha, Krishna Come Closer
videos.overview: Radha convinces Ayan to be friends with Krishna. She and Krishna come closer while she gives him dance lessons. Ayan is jealous to witness the same.

videos.title: Krishna to Persuade Radha
videos.overview: Krishna tries to convince Radha to unite Sudevi with her lover. Later, Kansa's aide threatens Nand Baba to handover Krishna to him.

videos.title: Krishna Seeks Attention
videos.overview: Krishna seeks Radha's attention by acting sick in front of her. Balram learns about Jatila's evil intentions and takes a shocking decision.

videos.title: Vrishbhan Ensures Krishna's Safety
videos.overview: Krishna pretends to be grateful to Ayaan for choosing to fight Kansa's soldiers. Vrishbhan and the others determine to protect Krishna from Kansa's army.

videos.title: Krishna Fights the Army
videos.overview: Krishna fights against Akrur's army and gives him an ultimatum. Akrur apologises to Krishna in the battleground. Will Radha witness Krishna's supremacy?

videos.title: Radha's Challenge to Krishna
videos.overview: Radha challenges Krishna to get Sudevi married to Bhairav. Later, Balram complains to Radha about Krishna's intentions.

videos.title: Radha Is Misled
videos.overview: Krishna and Balram mislead Radha about their true intentions. Later, Krishna plans to get Sudevi married to Bhairav.

videos.title: Radha Dances to Krishna's Music
videos.overview: Krishna plans to help Bhairav and Sudevi elope. Radha wants to foil Krishna's attempt and asks him to play the flute while she dances.

videos.title: Krishna Takes the Stage
videos.overview: Krishna goes on stage and starts dancing. He gives Radha dandiyas and invites her to join him, hoping to win her heart. Will his plan work?

videos.title: Radha Accuses Krishna
videos.overview: Krishna acts innocent when Radha accuses him of plotting to get Sudevi married to Bhairav. Radha corners Balram into confessing the truth.

videos.title: Krishna Disappoints Nand Baba
videos.overview: Upset with Krishna's deed, Nand Baba decides to leave Barsana. Krishna hopes that Sudevi acknowledges Bhairav's love when he gets punished.

videos.title: Radha's Promise to Vrishbhan
videos.overview: Krishna convinces Sudevi's father to let Sudevi marry Bhairav. An upset Vrishbhan asks Radha to make a promise when she does not tell him the truth.

videos.title: Krishna Bears the Brunt
videos.overview: Krishna is disheartened as Radha holds him responsible for the misunderstanding between her and Vrishbhan. She asks him to leave Barsana!

videos.title: Krishna's Clever Move
videos.overview: Krishna plans to change Radha’s perception about love. Kansa's aide attacks Barsana. Krishna tries to use this situation in his favour.

videos.title: Bakasur Creates Chaos
videos.overview: A demon named Bakasur creates chaos in Barsana. Ayan tries to fight back Bakasur, while Nand Baba waits for Krishna's arrival.

videos.title: Krishna Tricks Radha
videos.overview: Krishna playfully tricks Radha and starts to run when Bakasur tries to catch them. Later, he stops time for a moment and magically creates the Vrindavan forest.

videos.title: Krishna Gets Rid of Bakasur
videos.overview: Krishna kills Bakasur after he tries to harm Radha. Kansa is agitated to learn about Krishna's deed. Will Krishna reveal it all to Radha?

videos.title: Ayaan Assaults Krishna
videos.overview: Ayaan resolves to uncover the secret behind Krishna's powers and attacks him. Later, Radha is shocked when Krishna reads his thoughts.

videos.title: Krishna Prepares Kheer for Radha
videos.overview: Vrishbhan and his men desperately search for Radha while Krishna prepares delicious kheer for her. Later, Krishna feels odd when she refuses to eat the kheer.

videos.title: Krishna's Strict Order
videos.overview: Krishna orders the demon snake, Kaliya to leave the river near Gokul. But, Kaliya pays no heed to his words and challenges him.

videos.title: Rishi Durvasa Visits the Palace
videos.overview: Ayaan spikes the grains meant for the grand feast. Yashoda panics on learning about the rotten smell in the food prepared for Rishi Durvasa.

videos.title: Radha Seeks Durvasa's Blessings
videos.overview: Nand Baba tells Yashoda, Krishna and Balram to apologise to Rishi Durvasa. Radha brings food for Rishi Durvasa and seeks his blessings.

videos.title: Krishna Enters the River
videos.overview: Kaliya riles in pain when Krishna steps on his tail. Meanwhile, a distressed Yashoda pleads with Krishna to come out of the river.

videos.title: Kaliya Seeks Revenge
videos.overview: Radha fails miserably when she tries to outsmart Krishna. Kaliya seeks revenge against Krishna by poisoning the river water.

videos.title: Krishna Battles Kaliya
videos.overview: Everyone is shocked when Ayaan reveals that a giant snake has pulled Krishna into the river. Later, Krishna battles a furious Kaliya

videos.title: Krishna Forgives Kaliya
videos.overview: Krishna forgives Kaliya. Everyone is shocked to see him dancing on Kaliya's hood. Radha is in for a huge surprise.

videos.title: Radha Complains to Yashodha
videos.overview: Radha complains to Yashodha and Nand Baba that Krishna is a sorcerer. Krishna tries to prove that her claims are baseless.

videos.title: Radha Conducts the Puja
videos.overview: With a hidden agenda, Krishna ensures that Radha conducts the puja and makes her plant a Tulsi sapling in the village. Radha names the place Vrindavan.

videos.title: Radha Needs an Answer
videos.overview: After inferring that Krishna is trying to win her love, Radha confronts him about the same. Ayaan meets Kansa to plan his strategy against Krishna.

videos.title: Krishna Raises an Objection
videos.overview: Radha resolves to expose Krishna. Ayaan and Kansa plot to kill him. Later, Krishna objects Vrishbhan's decision.

videos.title: Krishna Manipulates Radha
videos.overview: Krishna manipulates Radha to participate in a contest. He tells her that she will have to sit with him on the swing as he is determined to make her win.

videos.title: Yashodha Punishes Krishna
videos.overview: Upset with Krishna's pranks, Yashodha ties him to a pillar. Radha rejoices as he is unable to participate in the contest.

videos.title: Krishna Challenges Radha
videos.overview: Radha tries to stop Krishna from using his tricks to participate in the match. He challenges her that Yashodha will free him.

videos.title: Krishna Vs Radha
videos.overview: Krishna takes part in the Rangoli competition in spite of his mother not letting him. However, Radha wins the Rangoli competition.

videos.title: Krishna Faces the Agitated Ox
videos.overview: Ayaan implements his evil plan. Krishna faces the agitated ox at the event and tries to prevent it from attacking Radha.

videos.title: Balram Persuades Radha
videos.overview: Krishna pretends to faint as he wants Radha to wake him up. Balram, through his strategy, tries to ensure that Radha fulfils Krishna's wish.

videos.title: Krishna's Plan for Radha
videos.overview: Kansa instigates Aghasur against Krishna. Meanwhile, Krishna intends to make Radha realise her true identity when she sits beside him on the swing.

videos.title: Agasur Attacks the Village
videos.overview: The villagers run helter-skelter as Agasur unleashes his fury on the village. Later, Krishna enlightens Balram about Brahma's boon which Agasur possess.

videos.title: Radha's Risky Move
videos.overview: Radha takes a drastic decision to save Vrishbhan from Agasur's clutches. Meanwhile, Krishna hopes that Radha conquers her fears.

videos.title: Radha Assaults Agasur
videos.overview: A fearless Radha assaults Agasur with Krishna's flute. Krishna is overwhelmed to witness her brave deed.

videos.title: Radha to Save Krishna
videos.overview: Radha succeeds to escape from Agasur's captivity but Krishna fails to escape. Later, Radha comes up with a plan to free Krishna.

videos.title: Radha Wants to Meet Krishna
videos.overview: Krishna misleads Kansa. Radha sets out to meet Krishna to thank him for helping her conquer her fears. Ayaan tries to stop her from meeting Krishna.

videos.title: Krishna Ignores Radha
videos.overview: Radha thanks Krishna and expresses her wish to be friends with him. However, Krishna turns down her friendship!

videos.title: Radha is Jealous
videos.overview: Ayaan is reluctant to tell Kansa that Krishna is alive, while Radha spots Krishna with her friends.

videos.title: Krishna's 'Friendship' Rules
videos.overview: Jhatila suggests a risky plan to Kansa. Meanwhile, Krishna presents some strange rules when Radha offers her friendship.

videos.title: Radha Stuns Her Family
videos.overview: Radha's family is stunned, noticing her peculiar behaviour. Meanwhile, Ayaan executes his evil plan against ?Vrishbhan and Nand.

videos.title: Will Radha Realize the Truth?
videos.overview: Ayaan's ploy lands Vrishbhan in trouble. Elsewhere, Radha's friend hints at her changed feelings for Krishna.

videos.title: Radha to Play a Game
videos.overview: Ayaan and his mother plan to break the friendship between Vrishbhan and Nand. Meanwhile, on Balram's suggestion, Radha plays a game with Krishna.

videos.title: A Special Medicine for Radha
videos.overview: Krishna prepares a medicine for Radha when she falls ill. Jhatila convinces Radha's friend to assist her in her evil ploy.

videos.title: Krishna's Raas Leela
videos.overview: Radha faces disappointment when she sneaks out of the house to meet Krishna at night.

videos.title: Radha Dances with Krishna
videos.overview: The music from Krishna's flute mesmerises Radha and the gopis and they dance together. Later, Radha finds herself in a spot when she returns home.

videos.title: Radha to Test Krishna
videos.overview: Ayaan confronts Jhatila for plotting against Radha. As per Vishakha's plan, Radha assigns a dangerous task to Krishna.

videos.title: Krishna vs Aristasur
videos.overview: Krishna climbs up a big mountain to bring a special flower for Radha. However, at the top, he engages in combat with Aristasur.

videos.title: Krishna Is Banished
videos.overview: Radha tries to confess her feelings to Krishna. As a result of Jhatila's vicious plan, Krishna is banished from the kingdom.

videos.title: Ayaan Makes a Revelation
videos.overview: Radha feels guilty for getting Krishna in trouble. Nand is stunned when Ayaan makes a shocking revelation about Krishna to Vrishbhan.

videos.title: Lord Shiva to Visit Barsana
videos.overview: Radha manages to stop Krishna from leaving Barsana. When the two indulge in a blissful Maharaas, even Lord Shiva decides to be a part of this divine celebration of pure love.

videos.title: Lord Shiva in a Disguise
videos.overview: Krishna is overwhelmed as Lord Shiva, disguised as a woman, joins him and Radha as they dance.

videos.title: Shiva's Gift to Radha
videos.overview: A disguised Shiva hands over a special gift to Radha. Krishna too presents her with Shaligram bracelet while Jhatila executes her evil plan against him.

videos.title: A Shocker for Radha
videos.overview: Vrishbhan shares details about the wedding proposal to Radha. Unable to defy her father's decision, a shattered Radha gives her consent to the marriage.

videos.title: Radha Reveals the Truth
videos.overview: While Ayaan relishes his victory over Krishna, Radha confides in her mother about her feelings for Krishna.

videos.title: A Secret Letter for Krishna
videos.overview: Radha requests Vishakha to hand over a secret letter to Krishna while Ayaan prepares to commit suicide.

videos.title: Krishna Reads Radha's Letter
videos.overview: Krishna reads Radha's letter stating that she loves him and asking him to stop her marriage. He visits Radha's house while she meets her prospective groom.

videos.title: Radha's Clever Plan
videos.overview: Krishna watches in awe as Radha tries to dissuade the prospective groom from accepting the marriage proposal.

videos.title: Radha Feels Helpless
videos.overview: Radha feels helpless when Krishna refuses to act while her family makes the arrangements for her wedding.

videos.title: Radha Seeks Krishna's Help
videos.overview: Radha seeks help from Krishna to call off her wedding, while Jhatila implements her plan to save Ayaan. Later, Vrishbhan confronts Radha.

videos.title: Vrishbhan's Uncontrolable Rage
videos.overview: Vrishbhan shoots sharp accusation at Nand on learning about Radha and Krishna's secret relationship.

videos.title: Krishna Faces Jhatila's Questions
videos.overview: Vrishbhan accuses Nand Baba of conspiring against him. Elsewhere, Jhatila questions Krishna if he loves Radha, while Radha hopes that Krishna will reciprocate her feelings.

videos.title: Radha Confronts Krishna
videos.overview: Vrishbhan and Nand Baba break all ties. Meanwhile, an agitated Radha confronts Krishna for hurting her feelings.

videos.title: Krishna Hurts Radha
videos.overview: Radha gets extremely furious when Krishna explains the difference between love and greed. Later, in a fit of rage, she does the unthinkable.

videos.title: Yashodha Suspects Krishna
videos.overview: Yashodha suspects that Krishna is the mastermind behind the conflict that has occurred. Krishna sneaks into Barsana while Radha’s pre-wedding rituals begin.

videos.title: Krishna Expresses His Love
videos.overview: Krishna confesses his love to Radha and tells her that he will not let her marry Vyomesh. Meanwhile, Jhatila and Ayaan have an evil plan in mind.

videos.title: Vyomasur Reveals It All!
videos.overview: Balram fights Vyomesh after he reveals his true identity. Later, Vyomasur tells Ayaan his real motive behind marrying Radha.

videos.title: Balram and Krishna are Accused
videos.overview: Vrishbhan confronts Nand Baba and accuses Balram of trying to kill Vyomesh. Later, Vrishbhan alleges that Krishna threatened Radha of foiling her marriage.

videos.title: Krishna's Feminine Avatar
videos.overview: Lord Shiva decides to help Krishna reunite with Radha. Later, on his insistence, Krishna takes up a feminine avatar.

videos.title: Gopadevi, Baldevi Fool Ayaan
videos.overview: Krishna and Balram disguise themselves as Gopadevi and Baldevi. They try to trick Ayaan and convince him to take them both to Barsana.

videos.title: Gopadevi Is up to Her Tricks
videos.overview: Gopadevi and Baldevi mislead Radha and Vrishbhan about their identity when they meet them. Later, Gopadevi asks Radha if she loves someone.

videos.title: Gopadevi Advises Radha
videos.overview: Gopadevi tries to change Radha's perception about love and advises her against getting married to someone she does not love. Meanwhile, Ayaan and Vyomasur are up to some foul play.

videos.title: Gopadevi Instigates Vyomesh
videos.overview: Krishna in the disguise of Gopadevi provokes Vyomesh to make Radha dance at the ceremony. Elsewhere, Balram dressed as Baldevi avoids Dhama, who is smitten with her.

videos.title: Radha, Gopadevi's Divine Synergy
videos.overview: Radha and Gopadevi aka Krishna, mesmerize the onlookers with their divine dance. Later, Ayaan assists a band of dacoits to enter the palace.

videos.title: Gopadevi, Baldevi Save the Day
videos.overview: Gopadevi and Baldevi rescue Radha by using witty tricks. Later, Gopadevi shocks Ayaan when she informs Vrishbhan about an ongoing conspiracy.

videos.title: Baldevi in an Awkward Situation
videos.overview: Gopadevi and Baldevi mislead Radha when she suspects them. Jhatila and Vyomasur speculate about Krishna's strategy, while Dhama proposes to Baldevi!

videos.title: Gopadevi, Baldevi in Trouble!
videos.overview: On learning about Gopadevi and Baldevi's real identity, Radha confronts Krishna for misleading her. She sets out to expose his and Balram's deceit to Vrishbhan.

videos.title: Radha's Shocking Demand
videos.overview: Radha decides to teach Krishna a lesson for hurting her feelings. Later, Krishna is shocked when Radha compels him to make a promise to her.

videos.title: Krishna Bids Farewell
videos.overview: Balram, bound by his promise to Krishna, is unable to disclose the truth about Vyomeshwar to Radha. Krishna sits alongside Radha as she performs the rituals during her sagaai ceremony.

videos.title: Gopadevi Provokes Vyomesh
videos.overview: After Vrishbhan announces the muhurat of her wedding, an emotionally stressed Radha faints. Later, Gopadevi instigates Vyomesh to call off his wedding.

videos.title: Gopadevi Makes Things Right
videos.overview: As a part of her ingenious plan, Gopadevi makes Vyomesh apologise to Vrishbhan. Later, he advises Radha when she questions her decision of marrying Vyomesh.

videos.title: Radha to Confront Krishna
videos.overview: Radha is distraught with Krishna's obscure behaviour and decides to confront him. Elsewhere, Krishna continues to puzzle Vyomesh.

videos.title: Radha's Haldi Rituals Begin
videos.overview: Ayan spots Yashoda trying to conceal herself. Ayan and Vyomesh are suspicious of Krishna's hallucination and they eagerly want to know the truth.

videos.title: Radha Plays the Flute!
videos.overview: Radha makes a flute for Krishna and plays it, grabbing his attention. Later, Kirtida becomes enraged when she finds out Gopadevi's real identity.

videos.title: Jatila Identifies the Truth
videos.overview: Jatila spots Yashodha and identifies Gopadevi and Baldevi's truth. Later, Radha decides to sacrifice her love for the sake of her father's prestige.

videos.title: Radha's Unexpected Move
videos.overview: Krishna reveals Vyomesh's real identity to Radha. Later, she takes an unexpected step when Ayaan tries to expose Krishna, Balram and Yashodha.

videos.title: Radha Misleads Vrishbhan
videos.overview: Radha foils Ayan's attempt to stir trouble by lying to Vrishbhan. Later, Krishna and Balram assist Yashodha to sneak out of Barsana.

videos.title: Krishna, Radha to Expose Vyomesh
videos.overview: Radha provokes Vyomesh against Krishna. Along with Krishna, she tactfully makes a fool out of Vyomesh and traps him in their plot.

videos.title: Krishna Exposes Vyomasur
videos.overview: Krishna successfully exposes Vyomasur. Later, Nand marches with his army towards Barsana on learning some shocking information.

videos.title: Krishna Rescues Radha
videos.overview: Kans incurs another massive defeat. Later, Krishna rescues Radha thus, putting an end to Nand and Vrishbhan's enmity.

videos.title: Balram Teases Krishna
videos.overview: Ayaan receives the honour of breaking the wall separating Barsana and Vrindavan. Later, Balram uses an ingenious tactic to tease Krishna.

videos.title: Ayan, Krishna Become Friends
videos.overview: Krishna tells Radha that their love is eternal and free from the obligations of marriage. Later, Ayan apologises to Krishna and wishes to be friends with him.

videos.title: What Is Ayan up to?
videos.overview: Balram doubts Ayan's intentions while Radha seeks a promise from Krishna. Later, Jhatila and Ayan visit the palace of Kans.

videos.title: Radha Relishes Krishna's Company
videos.overview: Krishna and Balram plan to set up a stall at the Basant Panchami fair. Later, an exhausted Balram deals with the customers while Krishna helps Radha in shopping.

videos.title: Radha Decides to Test Krishna
videos.overview: Balram’s innocence is misused at the fair as the customers begin to cheat him. Radha plans a test for Krishna after the couple confesses their feelings to each other.

videos.title: Radha's Behaviour Worries Krishna
videos.overview: Krishna feels worried, assuming that Radha is displeased with him. Later, he talks to Balram about Radha's jealousy.

videos.title: Radha is Being Possessive
videos.overview: Krishna tells Balram about Radha's possessiveness towards him. She is infuriated, spotting her cousin in Krishna's arms. Later, Krishna purposely makes her feel jealous

videos.title: Krishna Irks Radha
videos.overview: Krishna spends time with Chandravali, leaving Radha infuriated. Later, he continues to irk her even after she burns her fingers.

videos.title: Krishna's Odd Behaviour
videos.overview: Krishna requests Chandravali to show him some of her poetry, much to Radha's dismay. Later, Chandravali questions him regarding his relationship with Radha.

videos.title: Ayaan Misleads Radha
videos.overview: Radha lies to Chandravali in order to separate her from Krishna. Later, Ayaan tries to mislead Radha about Krishna and Chandravali's relationship.

videos.title: Chandravali Loves Krishna
videos.overview: Radha provokes Chandravali against Krishna when the latter reveals her love for him. Later, Chandravali takes her to Krishna for a confrontation.

videos.title: Jhatila Threatens Vishakha
videos.overview: Despite being falsely accused by Radha, Krishna accepts his mistakes. Later, Jhatila threatens to kill Vishakha's family if she refuses to mislead Radha.

videos.title: Krishna Receives a Punishment
videos.overview: While Radha and her friends are taking a bath in the river, Krishna steals their clothes. Later, Chandravali defends him when Yashoda ties Krishna to a pillar.

videos.title: Chandravali Loves Krishna
videos.overview: Yashoda asks Radha to apologise to Krishna. Later at night, Chandravali confesses her love to Krishna while Balram and Radha secretly witness the same.

videos.title: Krishna Reveals His Plan
videos.overview: Lord Shiv and Gauri are hurt by Krishna's deeds. Later, Krishna and Chandravali make a shocking disclosure to Balram. A distressed Radha grieves over her miseries.

videos.title: Radha Confronts Krishna
videos.overview: Kans schemes to kill Krishna. Later, an annoyed Radha stops Chandravali from meeting Krishna and sets out to tackle him herself.

videos.title: Radha Saves Krishna
videos.overview: Kans's poison makes the residents of Vrindavan ill. Later, Balram brings Radha to save Krishna after he absorbs the poison.

videos.title: Aayan's Vicious Trap
videos.overview: Aayan is pleased thinking that his ploy is taking shape. Radha grieves seeing Krishna injured. She decides to do anything to get him well.

videos.title: Radha Saves Krishna
videos.overview: When Kans is gearing up to kill Krishna, a distressed Radha prays to Narayan for a miracle. Later, she receives a divine message, which helps her to save Krishna.

videos.title: Radha Challenges Krishna
videos.overview: Vrishbhan gives the credit of Krishna's recovery to Chandravali. Later, a jealous Radha challenges Krishna for a competition, choosing Ayaan as her ally.

videos.title: Mahadev Visits Krishna
videos.overview: Radha makes an unexpected confession to Balram. Later, Krishna declares that his friend from Kailash will be the judge for the upcoming competition.

videos.title: Radha Competes With Krishna
videos.overview: Ayaan makes a shocking offer after Radha suffers an emotional outburst. Later, they compete against Krishna and Chandravali in an idol-making competition.

videos.title: Radha Gets Jealous
videos.overview: Krishna and Chandravali enact a play on Lord Shiva and Parvathi as a victory celebration. Later, following Ayaan's advice, a jealous Radha disappoints Bhatooknath.

videos.title: Radha Makes a Mistake
videos.overview: Krishna decides to teach Radha a lesson for not accepting her mistake. Meanwhile, Ayan brainwashes Radha into misunderstanding Krishna.

videos.title: Radha Confesses the Truth
videos.overview: Unable to bear the sight of Krishna carrying out the punishment, Radha confesses about feeling jealous of Chandravali in front of everyone. Later, Vrishbhan takes a shocking step.

videos.title: Radha Is Stunned
videos.overview: Radha successfully creates the Shivling, following which she learns a shocking truth. Later, she gets Bhatooknath married to Gowri on the occasion of Maha Shivratri.

videos.title: Ayaan Battles Kans
videos.overview: Kans and Ayaan engage in fierce combat. Elsewhere, Krishna shares a special moment with Radha.

videos.title: Krishna Is Outraged
videos.overview: Vrishbhan falls for Ayaan's trap as Krishna rushes to save him. Later, an inconsolable Radha runs out of the palace.

videos.title: Kans' Unusual Demand
videos.overview: After a shocking announcement, Kans demands that his chieftains gather in Mathura. Later, Ayaan nominates Radha as the representative of Barsana.

videos.title: Radha's Shocking Decision
videos.overview: Radha is reluctant to become the leader of Barsana while Kans gives Ayaan a magical diamond. Later, Radha announces her final decision.

videos.title: Radha's Coronation Ceremony
videos.overview: Despite Krishna's objection, Radha is declared the queen of Barsana after a grand ceremony. Later, a distressed Balram shares his concerns with Krishna.

videos.title: Radha Invites Trouble

videos.title: Krishna Attacks Banasur
videos.overview: Radha reminds Mahadev of his promise to Krishna. While Krishna launches a fierce attack on Banasur, Saambh faces his inevitable fate.

videos.title: Saambh's Sly Act
videos.overview: Lakshmana tries to instigate Jambavati against Radha. While Balram makes a shocking announcement, Saambh shoots a sharp accusation at Anirudh.

videos.title: Krishna Curses Saambh
videos.overview: A grave dilemma strikes Radha while Banasur spills the truth about Saambh's misdeeds. Later, Saambh faces Krishna's unthinkable curse.

videos.title: Radha's Shocking Promise
videos.overview: Banasur's proposal about Anirudh and Usha's marriage leaves Balram elated. Later, Radha makes a shocking promise to Jambavati.

videos.title: Dhanvantari Arrives to Meet Krishna
videos.overview: Radha meets Dhanvantari on her way to find medicine for Saambh. She brings him to the palace, only to find Krishna missing.

videos.title: Lakshmana Instigates Jambavati
videos.overview: Lakshmana tries to influence Jambavati against the rest of the family. Later, Krishna discloses an important secret to Balaram.

videos.title: Krishna Visits Mahadev
videos.overview: Krishna goes to Mahadev in a bid to wake him up from his deep slumber. At Dwarka, Lakshmana hatches an evil ploy against Radha.

videos.title: Radha Makes a Sacrifice
videos.overview: While Krishna informs Radha about Mahadev's slumber, Dhanvantari's revelation leaves her shocked. Later, Radha consumes the poisoned food.

videos.title: Saambh's Cunning Ploy
videos.overview: Lakshmana brews a diabolical plan while Saambh sends Rukmi a shocking letter. With a vicious plot in mind, Saambh assigns Rukmi a daunting task.

videos.title: Balram, Rukmi's Fierce Face-off
videos.overview: Rukmi challenges Balram for a game of dice while Saambh uses an evil trickery to recover himself. Later, Balram and Rukmi engage in a fierce battle.

videos.title: Can Krishna Save Dwarka?
videos.overview: While Radha takes the drastic step of leaving Dwarka, Saambh plans to drown the island kingdom. Will Radha come back in time for Krishna to save Dwarka?

videos.title: Saambh's Plan Goes Awry
videos.overview: Disappointment strikes Saambh after his plan goes awry. While Jambavati makes a shocking revelation about Samantak Mani, Saambh humiliates Krishna.

videos.title: Balram's Shocking Announcement
videos.overview: Saambh hatches an evil plan to destroy Dwarka. While Krishna asks Balram to protect Samantak Mani, the latter makes a shocking announcement.

videos.title: Saambh's Cunning Ploy
videos.overview: Saambh attempts to steal the Samantak Mani while the people of Dwarka face grave trouble. Later, Krishna's shocking revelation leaves everyone rattled.

videos.title: Radha Faces Humiliation
videos.overview: Balram confronts Krishna to spill the truth while the residents of Dwarka humiliate Radha. Meanwhile, Balram is hell-bent on finding the Samantak Mani.

videos.title: Radha in a Dilemma
videos.overview: Jambavati stops Balram from reaching the Samantak Mani. While Chandra Dev heeds to Saambh's prayers, Radha is in a quandary.

videos.title: Parvati Visits Radha
videos.overview: Krishna discloses to Radha that he is bound by the promise made to Chandra Dev. Heeding Radha's ardent prayers, Parvati visits her with a solution.

videos.title: Shree Ganesh's Brilliant Idea
videos.overview: Shree Ganesh brews an ingenious idea to find the Samantak Mani while Chandra Dev humiliates him. Later, Saambh faces Chandra Dev's unbridled fury.

videos.title: Balram in Quest of Samantak Mani
videos.overview: Balram, Anirudh, Nishath and Ulmuk encounter some ghosts in the forest.

videos.title: Saambh Faces Shree Ganesh's Wrath
videos.overview: Saambh and Shree Ganesh engage in a fierce battle while Surya Dev regains his power.

videos.title: Lakshmana Confronts Saambh
videos.overview: Krishna and Radha spend some blissful time while Lakshmana confronts Saambh.

videos.title: Krishna's Unusual Declaration
videos.overview: Radha is elated when a herd of cows from Barsana visits her.

videos.title: Krishna's Clever Plan
videos.overview: Jambavati gets petrified upon spotting Saambh in the disguise of a tiger.

videos.title: Balram's Heroic Act
videos.overview: Upon learning about Radha's sacrificial decision, Sudama and his family decide to end their lives.

videos.title: Saambh's Devious Plan
videos.overview: Saambh hatches a devious plan to thwart Radha and Krishna's union.

videos.title: Krishna's Story of Love
videos.overview: Krishna decides to take Radha to Golok and answer her queries on love through a story.

videos.title: Jambavati, Saambh's Devious Ploy
videos.overview: After Saambh overhears Krishna's story, he hatches a heinous plan along with Jambavati.

videos.title: An Enormous Task for Radha
videos.overview: Krishna goes into Samadhi and assigns Radha a task to protect him during his meditation.

videos.title: Parvati To Krishna's Aid!
videos.overview: Witnessing Shukracharya's vengeful intentions, Parvati comes to Krishna's aid.

videos.title: Saambh's Outrageous Act
videos.overview: Mahadev appears before Saambh to fulfil his demands.

videos.title: Radha Loses Her Memory
videos.overview: Radha forgets all about Krishna, Dwarka and also her own identity. While Jambavati rejoices, Krishna and others try to jog Radha's memory.

videos.title: Krishna's Shocking Announcement
videos.overview: Krishna attempts to stop Radha from leaving Dwarka. While Radha meets a disguised Mahadev, Krishna makes a shocking announcement.

videos.title: Mahadev's Adiyogi Avatar
videos.overview: Mahadev takes his Adiyogi avatar to help Radha regain her memory. While Saambh humiliates a disguised Mahadev, Krishna executes his quirky plan.

videos.title: Saambh Faces His Fate
videos.overview: Mahadev reveals his plan to jog Radha's memory. While Radha witnesses a past occurrence, Saambh faces his unfortunate fate.

videos.title: Radha Gets Closer to Her Fate
videos.overview: Radha takes yet another step towards getting closer to Krishna. On the other hand, Balaram bullies a tied-up Saambh.

videos.title: Krishna's Gift for Radha
videos.overview: Krishna keeps butter and fruits for Radha. Later, when Radha thinks about Gopal while relishing the gifts, Saambh tries to find Krishna.

videos.title: Gopal Stuns Radha
videos.overview: While Saambh's ploy falls short, Radha unknowingly witnesses the re-enaction of her and Krishna's love story. Later, Gopal visits Radha with a stunning information.

videos.title: Saambh's Spell Backfires
videos.overview: Saambh speaks rudely to Kishori and tries to attack Manmohan when the latter reverses Saambh's spell. Meanwhile, under the spell, Saambh ends up cross-dressing.

videos.title: Radha Feels Anxious
videos.overview: Radha confronts Gopal about purposely ignoring her but the latter denies doing it. Later, an anxious Radha confides in Adi Yogi about her feelings.

videos.title: Radha Confesses Her Feelings
videos.overview: Saambh helps Gopal make kheer so the latter can impress Radha, who confesses her love to Gopal after eating it. How will Gopal react?

videos.title: Saambh's Devious Ploy
videos.overview: Gopal takes Radha shopping and she is left elated. Meanwhile, Saambh takes help from Shukracharya to separate Krishna and Radha!

videos.title: Radha's Staunch Vow
videos.overview: Radha informs Adi Yogi about her love for Gopal and rejects Krishna's affection. Later, she takes a stern vow in front of Gopal.

videos.title: Radha Has Mixed Feelings
videos.overview: Radha hears Gopal and Krishna play the flute simultaneously and gets confused. When Gopal confesses his love to Radha, it leaves her with mixed feelings.

videos.title: Radha, Krishna Reunited!
videos.overview: While Radha and Krishna are reunited, Saambh is inflicted with a terrible curse. Later, an old enemy swears to take revenge against Krishna.

videos.title: Shukracharya's Master Plan
videos.overview: Shukracharya makes a master plan and with Saambh's help, simultaneously attacks Dwarka and Indralok. Meanwhile, Krishna makes a romantic promise to Radha.

videos.title: Saambh's Vile Conspiracy
videos.overview: Indra requests Krishna for help against Bali's attacks. Meanwhile, Saambh conspires with Shukracharya and Takshak to force Krishna to Paatal Lok.

videos.title: Indra Summons Devmata Aditi
videos.overview: Saambh comes to know some hidden secrets after he witnesses the occurrences in Paatal Lok. Later, Indra summons Devmata Aditi to save Dev Lok.

videos.title: Krishna Fulfills Aditi's Promise
videos.overview: Krishna fulfills Devmata Aditi's promise and gets reborn as her son. While he gains victory in the Dwarka war, Devmata Aditi convinces him to battle Bali.

videos.title: Shukracharya Traps Balaram
videos.overview: Balaram enters Paatal Lok to fulfil the promises made by Krishna. However, Shukracharya traps him and attempts to force Krishna into entering Paatal Lok.

videos.title: Mahadev Helps Krishna
videos.overview: Krishna faces an unexpected hurdle as Shukracharya closes the entry to Paatal Lok. Later, he receives the help of Mahadev and Devi Gauri.

videos.title: Krishna Enters Paatal Lok
videos.overview: Krishna enters the Paatal Lok and manages to overcome Danavraj Bal's illusions. Later, he arrives at Hatkeshwar Mahadev's territory and faces Vasuki.

videos.title: Krishna Befriends Vasuki
videos.overview: Krishna's act helps him befriend Vasuki and garner no resistance from Hatkeshwar Mahadev. While Bali and Shukracharya perform a Yagya, Krishna faces Takshak.

videos.title: Parvati Helps Krishna
videos.overview: While Krishna meditates to overcome the crisis, Sheshnaag and Vasuki battle Takshak. Later, Parvati gives a hint to Krishna to uncover an ally.

videos.title: Garud Defeats the Devas
videos.overview: To rescue Mata Vinanta, Garud accepts Mata Kadru's challenge of retrieving the Amrit Kalash. While he defeats the Devas, Indra seeks Narayan's help.

videos.title: Garud Wins Lord Vishu's Heart!
videos.overview: Garud wins Lord Vishnu's trust after forgiving Indra. Later, he visits Paatal Lok to bring the divine Amrit Kalash and fight the serpents.

videos.title: Mahadev Makes a Sacrifice
videos.overview: Mahadev decides to sacrifice Vasuki to ruin Bali's yagna, thus saddening Krishna. Later, Krishna sets forth a condition in front of a despondent Bali.

videos.title: Krishna's Staunch Decision
videos.overview: Shukracharya calls upon Brihaspati and ascertains Krishna's folly of ruining Bali's Yagna. Later, upon being accused, Krishna inflicts a punishment upon himself.

videos.title: Krishna Reveals His Distress
videos.overview: Krishna tells Balaram about the curse being the reason for his decision. Meanwhile, Jambavati gives Saambh some advice.

videos.title: Dejection Strikes Radha
videos.overview: Radha is dejected about being departed from Krishna. While she refuses to perform Saraswati Puja, Devi Parvati gives her some valuable advice.

videos.title: Radhas Difficult Boon
videos.overview: Lakshmana and Jambavati worry about Saambh's meditation. A shock awaits Krishna as he discovers about Radha's terrible boon from Maa Saraswati.

videos.title: Krishna Seeks a Boon
videos.overview: Saraswati blesses Saambh to fulfill Radha's boon while Krishna breaks down. Later, Krishna seeks a wish from the Goddess for Radha.

videos.title: Saambh Vows to End Krishna!
videos.overview: Seeing the celebratory environment of Holi in Dwarka, Saambh fumes with rage and vows to wreak havoc. On the other hand, Radha expresses her wish to Krishna.

videos.title: Saambh Manipulates Yamuna
videos.overview: Saambh employs manipulative tactics and instigates Yamuna against Krishna. While he convinces her to seek Shani's help, Krishna decides to visit Vrindavan.

videos.title: Krishna Fears the Worst
videos.overview: While Yamuna wrecks havoc in Vrindavan, Krishna fears the awakening of Shani. Later, Saambh convinces Yamuna to seek Shani's help to tackle Krishna.

videos.title: Shani's Unbridled Wrath
videos.overview: Krishna reveals the untold past between Shani and him to Radha. While Shani's fury wrecks havoc in Vrindavan, Krishna plans to prevent Yamuna's meeting.

videos.title: Saambh Intsigates Shani
videos.overview: Saambh faces Shani's uncontrollable anger. Meanwhile, Shani goes to meet Krishna after Saambh attempts to instigate Shani against Krishna.

videos.title: Krishna, Yamuna's Wedding Tale
videos.overview: Krishna calms down a devastated Yamuna. Later, Krishna tells Radha about his marriage with Yamuna.

videos.title: Yamuna Realises Her Folly
videos.overview: Yamuna admits her folly of summoning Shani Dev and inciting his anger. As Radha gets tensed, Krishna reiterates the tale of Shani Dev.

videos.title: Mahadev Helps Krishna
videos.overview: Krishna narrates the incident that led to Shani's designation as the God of Karma. Later, Mahadev buys time for Krishna by delaying Shani's retaliation.

videos.title: Saambh Seeks to Meet Shani
videos.overview: Yamuna attempts to convince Shani to forgive Krishna. While Mahadev brews a plan, Saambh seeks Yamuna's permission to meet Shani.

videos.title: Krishna to Save Mahadev
videos.overview: Mahadev disguises himself as a sage to hide from Shani. Elsewhere, Krishna executes a clever plan to save Mahadev from Shani's Vakradrushti.

videos.title: Mahadev Is Captured
videos.overview: Under Kashiraj's orders, Mahadev is captured and produced before him. Later, Krishna confronts Shani as the latter lands Mahadev into deep trouble.

videos.title: Shani Is Remorseful
videos.overview: Shani expresses his grief to Krishna while Mahadev makes a revelation. Meanwhile, Shani grows remorseful after learning a grave truth.

videos.title: Shani Targets Krishna
videos.overview: Shani realises his mistake and stops the execution of Mahadev. However, he remains adamant about unleashing his Vakradrishti on Krishna.

videos.title: Shani's Heartfelt Apology
videos.overview: Shani makes a heartfelt apology to Krishna and the latter asks Shani to participate in Gauri-Shankar's Puja. Later, Saambh faces Shani's unbridled wrath.

videos.title: Krishna Spills a Foreboding Truth
videos.overview: Krishna tells Balaram that soon the world will fall into chaos, rendering the latter speechless. Meanwhile, Radha and others prepare to celebrate Holi in Dwarka.

videos.title: Krishna, Radha Remain Reluctant
videos.overview: Saambh refuses to play Holi after falling into the pool of blue ink. Later, a heartbroken Radha and a dejected Krishna refuse to play Holi.

videos.title: Radha's Unusual Plan
videos.overview: When Krishna rejects Radha's idea to play Holi with her, the latter conjures up a plan. She lures Krishna, and he falls in a mud pool.

videos.title: Radha to Surprise Krishna
videos.overview: While Krishna plays a prank on Radha, the latter plans to surprise him on the eve of Holi. However, Krishna and Mahadev grow worried about her plan.

videos.title: Radha, Krishna's Lathmar Holi
videos.overview: On the occasion of Lathmar Holi, Radha gets enthusiastic to celebrate it with Krishna. However, Krishna refuses to play, unaware of Saambh watching them.

videos.title: Radha to Please Krishna
videos.overview: Radha performs a special ritual to please Krishna, but Samba finds out about her plan and decides to ruin it for her.

videos.title: Saambh's Devious Ploy
videos.overview: Radha attempts to bridge the gap between her and Krishna. While she decides to play Holi with Krishna, Saambh puts his devious plan into motion.

videos.title: Krishna's Smart Move
videos.overview: When Saambh sneakily burns Radhas dhatu, Krishna suggests to play water Holi. A distraught Radha looks at the fire, unaware of Krishna's move.

videos.title: Krishnas Important Advice
videos.overview: When Radha smears ash on Krishna, the colour at the festival turn into ash. Later, Radha receives an important advice from Krishna and celebrates Holi with him.

videos.title: Radha's Request to Krishna
videos.overview: Radha and Krishna play the most magnificent Holi that Dwarka has ever seen. Later, Radha makes a request to Krishna.

videos.title: Krishna Is Remorseful
videos.overview: Krishna grows remorseful about a past decision while Mahadev tries to pacify him. Meanwhile, Krishna foretells about an impending danger.

videos.title: Shankhachur, Indra's Fierce Clash
videos.overview: Shankhachur and Indra engage in a fierce fight. While Indra seeks Mahadev's help to kill Shankhachur, Radha searches for Krishna.

videos.title: Radha Grows Enraged
videos.overview: Radha loses her cool after Krishna reveals Sridhama's curse from their past life. Elsewhere, Suryadev tries to brew a plan to defeat Shankhachur.

videos.title: Suryadev Seeks Radha's Help
videos.overview: Suryadev and other Gods seek Radha's help to save them from Shankhachur's wrath. Later, all the Gods and Shankhachur engage in a deadly battle.

videos.title: Shankhachur in Trouble!
videos.overview: Shankhachur's wife feels guilty after she learns about his misdeeds. While he loses his powers, Radha and Krishna engage in friendly banter.

videos.title: Shankhachur's Arrogant Answer
videos.overview: An arrogant Shankhachur ilItreats Tulsi when she questions him about his love. While Radha asks Krishna to spill the truth, he enlightens her.

videos.title: Shankhachur to Attack Kailash
videos.overview: Radha enlightens Tulsi about the sanctity of her love towards Shankhachur. Later, Shankhachur plans to attack Kailash.

videos.title: Tulsi's Outrageous Decision
videos.overview: Shankhachur, along with his troops, arrives at Kailash to attack. While Krishna makes Radha envious, Tulsi takes an outrageous decision.

videos.title: Shankhachur Demands War
videos.overview: On behalf of Mahadev, Devi Parvati takes the form of Maa Kali to battle Shankhachur. However, Krishna stops the fierce combat and convinces Shankhachur otherwise.

videos.title: The End of Shankhachur
videos.overview: Devi Tulsi expresses her affection to Shankhachur before their wedding ceremony. Later, Mahadev attacks an arrogant Shankhachur for misusing Devi Tulsi's affection.

videos.title: Devi Tulsi Curses Krishna
videos.overview: After the death of her lover Shankhachur, Devi Tulsi fumes in anger and places a deadly curse on Krishna. Later, Radha pleads for mercy.

videos.title: The End of Krishna?
videos.overview: Krishna returns to Dwaraka and tells everyone about the curse. After he spends his last moments with Radha, Krishna turns into a stone.

videos.title: Radha's Request to Saambh
videos.overview: When Saambh pretentiously goes to help Radha, she makes a request to him. Later, Saambh provokes Devi Tulsi against Krishna.

videos.title: A Shocker for Devi Tulsi
videos.overview: Devi Tulsi arrives and tells Radha that her sacrificial act is meaningless. However, she is shocked to learn about the ultimate sacrifice Radha is ready to make.

videos.title: Shukracharyas Ploy Fails
videos.overview: Radha toils hard to give shape to Krishna's idol. Later, Shukracharya's ploy fails as Saambh's attempt to eradicate Krishna's idol turns ineffective.

videos.title: Radha Searches for the Idol
videos.overview: As Krishna's idol suddenly disappears, Radha looks for it everywhere. Later, Mahadev prophesies Krishna's arrival in a new avatar.

videos.title: Krishna's New Avatar
videos.overview: Radha and Balaram are perplexed as the idol mysteriously appears in front of them. Later, Krishna emerges in his new avatar and meets Radha.

videos.title: Krishna Helps Radha
videos.overview: Krishna decides to help Radha in finding the idol. Later, Radha advises Devi Tulsi to forgive Krishna and end his curse.

videos.title: Radha Is Questioned
videos.overview: Lakshmana vows to kill Radha when she suspects her strange behaviour. Later, Radha is questioned by Lakshmana as she attempts to trick her.

videos.title: Banke Recites a Poem
videos.overview: Krishna meets Radha as Banke Bihari and recites a beautiful poem to her. Meanwhile, Devi Tulsi demands answers from Mahadev.

videos.title: Mahadev Saves Devi Tulsi
videos.overview: While Saambh plans to target Radha, Mahadev saves Devi Tulsi's life during her tapasya. Later, Radha decides to prove that Banke is not an imaginary person.

videos.title: Banke, Radha Take a Challenge
videos.overview: Banke and Radha take a painting challenge before the villagers. As the competition takes place, Devi Parvati is eager to find out who will win.

videos.title: Radha Faces an Obstacle
videos.overview: Banke informs Radha that she can call out to Krishna whenever she wants to. Later, Radha is in trouble as she encounters Dantavakra.

videos.title: Krishna Marries Tulsi
videos.overview: Balaram finds it difficult to fight Dantavakra and rescue Radha from his clutches. Elsewhere, Krishna is relieved from the curse as Tulsi marries Krishna.

videos.title: Banke Befriends Dantavakra
videos.overview: Banke comes to rescue Radha and Balaram from Dantavakra's clutches. However, they are perplexed as Banke befriends him and urges them to surrender.

videos.title: Dantavakra Learns the Truth
videos.overview: Dantavakra confronts Banke for tricking him. While he is shocked to learn about his past, the curse on Krishna gets lifted.

videos.title: Krishna Kills Dantavakra
videos.overview: Krishna saves Radha and Balaram by defeating Dantavakra. While he reveals the truth about Banke, Radha makes a shocking announcement.

videos.title: Radha Upsets Hanuman
videos.overview: Hanuman gets upset when Radha announces that she is the greatest disciple. While Krishna urges Radha to take back her proclamation, Hanuman leaves for Dwarka.

videos.title: Krishna Welcomes Hanuman
videos.overview: Krishna prepares a feast for Hanuman to welcome him to Dwarka. Meanwhile, Hanuman gets into a conflict with Garud Dev when he insults Shri Ram.

videos.title: Ram Blesses Hanuman
videos.overview: Hanuman accepts Garud's challenge after receiving the blessings of Shri Ram. While Suryadev fears the return of Hanuman, Krishna narrates a glorious tale.

videos.title: Hanuman Arrives at Dwarka
videos.overview: Garud and Suryadev feel inspired after their encounter with Hanuman. Later, he reaches Dwarka and grows curious about Krishna.

videos.title: Hanuman Relishes the Feast
videos.overview: Hanuman savours the spread of delicious laddoos prepared by Radha. While Balaram and Radha search for him, Saambh devises an evil plan.

videos.title: Hanuman Meets Radha
videos.overview: Hanuman introduces himself to Radha and requests her to retract from her proclamation. Later, Balaram and his men fail to capture Hanuman.

videos.title: Hanuman's Devotion Towards Dwarka
videos.overview: Hanuman sets his goal to fill Dwarka with love and devotion. Further, he executes his first plan towards Saambh.

videos.title: Hanuman, Radha's Big Challenge
videos.overview: Hanuman and Radha challenge each other on who is the greatest god, Shri Ram or Krishna. As the competition opens up to the citizens of Dwarka, Hanuman has touble finding a neutral judge.

videos.title: Radha Learns about Hanuman
videos.overview: Radha finds out about Hanuman's tremendous powers from Krishna. While she seeks Parvati's help, Balaram makes a revelation to Krishna.

videos.title: Another Win for Krishna
videos.overview: Krishna's plan gets successful as he convinces Radha to retain the challenge. However, Hanuman grows worried as Radha is eager to face him.

videos.title: Hanuman's Active Participation
videos.overview: Hanuman tries to apprehend Mahadev's hint about Radha's weapon. Later, Hanuman partakes in the competition and proves his power of devotion.

videos.title: Radha Wins the Challenge
videos.overview: Radha proves her devotion towards Krishna and wins the challenge which leaves Hanuman surprised. Later, Sambh prepares for his next move against Krishna.

videos.title: Saambh Instigates Shani
videos.overview: Hanuman apologises to Krishna and promises to teach Saambh a lesson. On the other hand, Saambh makes a clever move and summons Shani.

videos.title: Hanuman Teaches a Lesson
videos.overview: Hanuman engages in a face-off with Shani and wins the fight. Later, he tends to Shani, who understands his mistakes.

videos.title: Tricky Situation for Hanuman
videos.overview: Radha prepares sweets to make Hanuman feel at home in Dwarka. While he is confident about his victory, Krishna's statement puts him in a dilemma.

videos.title: Krishna's Ram Avatar!
videos.overview: After reaching Kishkinda, Hanuman receives an important mission from Shri Ram. Later, Krishna transforms into his Ram avatar in front of Hanuman.

videos.title: Hanuman's Divinity for Ram
videos.overview: Hanuman expresses his sentiments for Lord Ram before the villagers. On witnessing their dedication and divinity, Lord Ram showers them with his blessings.

videos.title: Krishna Embraces Balaram
videos.overview: An infuriated Balaram becomes calm after Krishna hugs him. Meanwhile, Hanuman feels Radha is as concerned about him as Sita was.

videos.title: Hanuman Reveals the Truth
videos.overview: Hanuman tries his best to get Radha to recognise him but fails. After Krishna gives him an idea, Hanuman tells her the truth.

videos.title: Krishna Advises Hanuman
videos.overview: Seeing Hanuman upset, Balaram reveals his truth to him. While he is elated, Krishna advises him on how to make Radha aware of the eternal reality.

videos.title: Hanuman Glad to Help
videos.overview: Radha grows curious about the special arrangements at the newly built temple. While Hanuman expresses his eagerness to help, Krishna appreciates his service.

videos.title: Hanuman's Idol Is Established
videos.overview: At Krishna's behest, Mahadev arrives in Dwarka. In the presence of Radha and Balram, Krishna establishes Hanuman's idol, declaring him a true devotee.

videos.title: Alakshmi Creates Chaos
videos.overview: The residents of Dwarka are taken aback when Alakshmi wreaks havoc using dark magic. Krishna narrates the tale of Alakshmi's past.

videos.title: Alakshmi Unleashes Her Wrath
videos.overview: A furious Alakshmi commands Jvarasura to torture the residents of Dwarka. While they assume it to be Radha, Krishna meets Alakshmi.

videos.title: Devi Sheetala to Help Radha
videos.overview: Alakshmi challenges Radha and manifests her sinister plan. After Radha pleads Parvati for help, Devi Sheetala comes to her aid.

videos.title: Alakshmi Enters Dwarka
videos.overview: A furious battle between Jvarasura and Devi Sheetala commences. After accepting Alakshmi's condition, Krishna puts forth a challenge and allows her to enter Dwarka.

videos.title: Krishna on the Meaning of Love
videos.overview: While Radha welcomes Alakshmi in Dwarka, Krisha teaches her the meaning of love. Later, Alakshmi manifests her sinister trap.

videos.title: Radha Confesses Her Love
videos.overview: Saambh joins hands with Alakshmi in her devil plan. On the other hand, Radha confesses her selfless love for Krishna.

videos.title: Jambavati Pays a Price
videos.overview: Jambavati asks Kuber for a large sum of his gold, unaware that she has to pay a heavy price for it. On seeing her repent her actions, Krishna tells her Maha Lakshmi's Katha.

videos.title: Krishna Recites Lakshmi Katha
videos.overview: Krishna recites Lakshmi Katha, setting an example of Treta Yug. But, Alakshmi's evil intentions affect everyone and ignites greed in them.

videos.title: Radha Helps Jambavati
videos.overview: Radha plays a game to make Jambavati understand the meaning of Dhan Lakshmi. Later, they make a devotional call to Lakshmi.

videos.title: Alaksmi's Diabolical Plan
videos.overview: Krishna promises Radha, that he will not restrict her from helping Alakshmi. To put Radha in trouble, Alakshmi prepares tasteless food and invites the Monks for a meal.

videos.title: Alaksmi Frames Radha
videos.overview: As the women in the kitchen fall sick due to Alaksmi's spell, Radha gets into trouble. Later, she blames Radha for spoiling the refreshments meant for the monks.

videos.title: Krishna Recites Lakshmi Katha
videos.overview: Alaksmi comes up with an evil plan when Radha is asked to prepare food for the Rishis. To calm down the enraged Rishis, Krishna recites Dhanya Lakshmi Katha.

videos.title: Radha Receives Blessings
videos.overview: The Rishis ask for forgiveness from Dhan Lakshmi at Radha's request. They bless Radha as she wins their hearts by serving delicious food.

videos.title: Alakshmi's Wicked Resolution
videos.overview: Krishna predicts something unusual about the day of Purnima. Later, Alakshmi resolves to evoke sadness in Dwarka before Purnima.

videos.title: Krishna Forgets to Play the Flute
videos.overview: Alakshmi causes hindrance when Krishna begins narrating a tale on Vidhyalakshmi. The villagers are stunned as Krishna fails to remember how to play the flute.

videos.title: Radha Loses Her Memory
videos.overview: Alakshmi is thrilled when Radha loses her complete memory. While Krishna helps Radha recollect, she confronts Alakshmi about her wicked intentions.

videos.title: Radha, Alakshmi at War!
videos.overview: Radha poses a challenge to Alakshmi, asking her to win Krishna over. Accepting the same, Alakshmi accumulates her supreme powers troubling Dwarka.

videos.title: Krishna Recites Parvati Katha
videos.overview: To get rid of the negativity, Krishna decides to recite Devi Parvati Sati Swarup Katha. Later, Krishna takes a significant decision on Radha's insistence.

videos.title: Krishna Presents a Proposal
videos.overview: Krishna defines the meaning of love as Radha makes a sacrifice. Later, she admits her failure when Krishna proposes to divide him into two equal pieces.

videos.title: Alakshmi Realises True Love
videos.overview: Alakshmi apologises to Radha after realising the true meaning of love. As she unites Radha and Krishna, he appreciates every woman who loves unconditionally.

videos.title: Mahadev's Plea to Krishna
videos.overview: To save Dwarka from Alakshmi's evil traces, Mahadev requests Krishna to perform Ashwamedha Yagya. When Krishna refuses him, he comes up with another plan.

videos.title: Narada Plans Ashwamedha Yagya
videos.overview: As Mahadev convinces Narada, he meets Rukmini and Radha to execute his idea. Later, Krishna appears as Narada discusses his plan for Ashwamedha Yagya with Radha.

videos.title: Krishna Refuses the Yagya
videos.overview: Krishna confronts Narada about the Ashwamedha Yagya. While Narada tries to evade him, Krishna declines to participate in the Yagya.

videos.title: Krishna's Wives Are Welcomed
videos.overview: Narad Muni greets each wife of Krishna for the Ashwamedha Yagya. Elsewhere, Balaram gets worried as he is unable to bring an Ashwa for the Yagya.

videos.title: Krishna Tricks Radha
videos.overview: While Radha persuades Krishna's wives for the Ashwamedha Yagya, Narad Muni applauds her. Later, Radha's genius plan fails as Krishna tricks her.

videos.title: Krishna Pranks Narad Muni
videos.overview: Krishna plays a prank on Narad Muni as he plans to trap him for the yagya. Later, Saambh gets determined to seperate Krishna and Radha.

videos.title: Parvati Advises Narad Muni
videos.overview: Narad Muni lands in a fix as Krishna wants him to select the wife for the Yagya. As he decides to leave, Devi Parvati comes up with a solution.

videos.title: Radha to Make a Choice
videos.overview: Radha gets into a dilemma when Narada urges her to choose Krishna's wife for the Yagya. While Krishna stops her, she accepts Narada's plea.

videos.title: Krishna Performs Mahadev Pooja
videos.overview: Krishna teaches Chayan to Radha as she gets upset about his fasting. As he performs the Mahadev Pooja, she insists on fasting too.

videos.title: Saambh's Evil Act
videos.overview: Radha decides to drink milk to break Krishna's fast. However, Saambh comes up with a wicked plan to hurt Krishna.

videos.title: Saambh Accuses Radha
videos.overview: Saambh blames Radha for conspiring against Krishna's wives and decides to prove it. Later, Narada conveys Krishna's idea to help Radha in the selection process.

videos.title: Saambh's Shrewd Manipulation
videos.overview: Saambh tries to influence the situation to stop Radha from selecting a wife for the Yagya. He suggests donating gold while Radha is about to declare her choice.

videos.title: Krishna's Tula Daan
videos.overview: To choose a wife for the Yagya, Saambh organises Tula Daan for Krishna. Later, Saambh and others get elated to experience a miracle.

videos.title: Radha Excpresses Her Love
videos.overview: When Saambh plots revenge against Krishna, the Ashwa escapes from the trap. Later, Balaram is astounded by the definition of love from Radha.

videos.title: Radha to Save Krishna
videos.overview: Radha initially refuses to remove the thorn from Krishna's body to respect Rukmini's wishes. But she decides to save him when he faces deep agony.

videos.title: Krishna Calls Off the Yagna
videos.overview: Radha tells Krishna that Rukmini should not participate in the Ashwamedha Yagna with him. To cater to her wish, Krishna calls off the Yagna.

videos.title: Devi Parvati's Request to Krishna
videos.overview: Devi Parvati expresses her desire to witness Bal Ganesha, but Lord Shiva denies it. Later, Krishna fulfils her demand.

videos.title: Ganesha's Mischievous Acts
videos.overview: Mahadev complains to Krishna about Ganesha as he snatches away his Trishula. Later, Ganesha gets curious about the strongest weapon in the world.

videos.title: Mahadev Grows Angry
videos.overview: Krishna enjoys the meal together with the Gods and Ganesha. An angry Mahadev scolds Ganesha as he eats all the Modaks after Krishna provokes him.

videos.title: Mahadev Comes up with a Plan
videos.overview: Ganesha is upset as Mahadev scolds him for eating Modak. Later, Mahadev comes up with a plan to make Krishna meet Ganesha.

videos.title: Ganesha Arrives at Dwarka
videos.overview: Realising Mahadev's plan, Krishna decides to leave Dwarka and take Vishnu's avatar. Upon Ganesha's arrival, the people of Dwarka are ecstatic.

videos.title: Ganesha Makes an Attempt
videos.overview: Radha is upset as she fails to feed the Modaks to Ganesha. Elsewhere, Ganesha makes several attempts to take the Sudarshan Chakra.

videos.title: Ganesha Drinks the Kshira Sagar
videos.overview: To awaken Krishna for the Sudarshan Chakra, Ganesha drinks the milk from Kshira Sagar. As he fails to find Ganesha, Balaram lands in deep trouble.

videos.title: Balaram's Request to Ganesha
videos.overview: Balaram finds Ganesha and urges him to replenish the Kshira Saga. Later, Ganesha agrees after Parvati requests him.

videos.title: The Birth of Ganesha
videos.overview: Vinayak was a gritty little boy who lost his life at Mahadev's hands because he followed Parvati's advice. To placate her anger, Mahadev created Ganesha.

videos.title: Ganesha's Request to Radha
videos.overview: Ganesha finds Radha, and she feeds him a Modak. He then makes an innocent request, and she goes to execute his plan.

videos.title: Krishna to Teach Ganesha
videos.overview: Krishna decides to take Ganesha with him to Dwarka for instilling knowledge within him. Meanwhile, Radha prepares an ostentatious feast for his welcome.

videos.title: Ganesha Avoids Krishna
videos.overview: Ganesha's team of mice find out the Modaks prepared by Radha. Later, to evade Krishna's questions about the Sudarshan Chakra, Ganesha avoids him.

videos.title: Ganesha's Mischievous Act
videos.overview: After hearing about Krishna's escapades with stealing butter, Ganesha tries it himself. He then uses his mice team and steals all the butter from Dwarka.

videos.title: Ganesha Frames Krishna
videos.overview: When Krishna asks about the butter thief, a guilty Ganesha frames Krishna. Later, he tells Ganesha a story to make him realise his mistake.

videos.title: Krishna's Lesson to Ganesha
videos.overview: While Ganesha and Krishna win the food task, Krishna gives him a valuable advice on winning. With Krishna's help, Ganesha successfully plays the flute.

videos.title: Krishna Defeats Saambh
videos.overview: Saambh wants to prove to Ganesha that his jhula is the strongest. However, Krishna wins the competition as Saambh falls from his jhula.

videos.title: Ganesha Accuses Saambh
videos.overview: Radha and Krishna gift Ganesha a peacock feather by letting him win the competition. Saambh counter questions Ganesha after he blames him for stealing his Modaks.

videos.title: Veda Vyasa Chooses Ganesha
videos.overview: Krishna welcomes Veda Vyasa at his place. Ganesha agrees to perform the task for popularity while Veda Vyasa chooses him after getting impressed.

videos.title: Ganesha's Great Sacrifice
videos.overview: Ganesha starts to write Mahabharata as Veda Vyasa dictates. Ganesha sacrifices his tooth to carry on his writing while the pen breaks due to Saambh's plot.

videos.title: Ganesha Confesses the Truth
videos.overview: Ganesha blames Saambh for the loss of his tooth, but he forgives him with an open heart. Later, he admits his act of hiding Sudarshana Chakra to Radha.

videos.title: Krishna Briefs Ganesha
videos.overview: Ganesha listens carefully while Krishna elaborates the stories of his various avatars. When Mohasur arrives at Dwarka, Krishna gets a premonition.

videos.title: Parvati Gives an Ultimatum
videos.overview: Radha stands up to Mohasur and refuses to let him take Ganesha away. When all fails, Radha faces Parvati, who gives her an ultimatum to return Ganesha.

videos.title: Krishna Gets Defeated
videos.overview: Ganesha hides to avoid Mohasur when Krishna denies fighting the former. Further, Krishna fights with Mohasur to avoid destruction but is defeated.

videos.title: Ganesha Grows Victorious
videos.overview: Ganesha chooses the path of truth by returning Krishna his Sudarshana Chakra. Mohasur liberates Radha and Parvati from his spell after Ganesha wins over him.

videos.title: Radha Grows Upset
videos.overview: A sad Radha decides not to participate in the Janmashtami celebration. Later, Ganesha questions her when he finds her in tears.

videos.title: Krishna Janmashtami Special!
videos.overview: On the occasion of Janmashtami, the Gods meet Krishna to honour the festival. Krishna and Radha enter the galaxy as twinkling stars shower over them.

videos.title: Radha Gets Kidnapped
videos.overview: Radha waits for Krishna when Shukracharya tells Saambh of the end of her curse. Later, Shukracharya kidnaps Radha before her life takes an auspicious turn.

videos.title: Krishna's Arduous Effort
videos.overview: Devi Parvati fumes with anger and decides to finish Shukracharya's powers for trapping Radha. After following Krishna's flute, can Radha reach him?

videos.title: Radha, Krishna Return to Dwarka
videos.overview: Hundred years ahead, Radha and Krishna spend time together on their swing. However, they decide to return to Dwarka and meet their associates.

videos.title: Radha's Strong Wish
videos.overview: Radha desires to settle with Krishna at Goloka, but he refuses to do so. However, against Krishna's wish, she leaves Dwarka to reunite with him at Goloka.

videos.title: Radha Goes Back to Dwarka
videos.overview: As Radha leaves for Goloka, Krishna is unable to stop her. However, Balram's questions compel her to return back to Dwarka.

videos.title: Krishna's Ultimatum to Radha
videos.overview: Radha leaves Dwarka and hides from Krishna in a cave. However, Krishna arrives at the cave and asks her to come out or else he will never meet her again.

videos.title: Radha, Krishna Makes a Promise
videos.overview: On Radha's insistence, Krishna promises to end their relationship of love. Elsewhere, the dwellers of Dwarka get excited to welcome them.

videos.title: Krishna's Promise to Balaram
videos.overview: Balaram expresses his concern to Krishna about Radha. However, Krishna dimisses his query by stating that his love with Radha is eternal.

videos.title: Saambh's Evil Resolution
videos.overview: Krishna welcomes the Yaduvanshis and makes Saambh their representative. Later, an evil Saambh resolves to destroy Krishna.

videos.title: Krishna's Request to Radha
videos.overview: Radha attempts to end Krishna's suffering by stopping time which puts the world in danger. Later, Krishna tries to reason with Radha in order to save the world.

videos.title: Krishna Makes a Sacrifice
videos.overview: Krishna gives up all his powers and tells Radha that he will be killed if she destroys the world. Saambh learns about the former's weakness and plans an attack.

videos.title: Krishna's Plea to Balaram
videos.overview: With the help of Devaki, Krishna manages to comfort a sad Radha. Later, he asks Balaram to accompany Saambh and Anirudh to unite the Yaduvanshis.

videos.title: Krishna's Dream Comes True
videos.overview: Radha makes Krishna's dream a reality by inviting Gopikas to cook for him. Later, Saambh and Balaram's plan to set Anirudh up works in their favour.

videos.title: Radha Turns Jealous
videos.overview: Krishna praises the dessert prepared by the Gopikas when a jealous Radha finds it tasteless. The Gopikas groom Krishna while Balaram, Anirudh, and Saambh are absent.

videos.title: Krishna's Big Plans for Radha
videos.overview: Balram refuses to fight with Bhaldev on Saamb's advice, to rescue Anirudh. Elsewhere, Krishna prepares for a grand event to celebrate Radha's birthday.

videos.title: Krishna's Astute Plan
videos.overview: Despite Krishna's request, Saambh is ready to declare a war against the Yaduvanshis. Later, Krishna has a clever plan to get Anirudh back.

videos.title: Krishna's Genius Strategy
videos.overview: Krishna invites Somdev and Baldev as chief guests for the ceremony, and both give up the war out of respect. Later, Baldev returns Anirudh to Krishna.

videos.title: Radha, Krishna's Celebration
videos.overview: While Radha grows worried about Krishna, he celebrates her birthday. Further, Krishna fulfils Devki's miracle wish.

videos.title: Devki Becomes Nostalgic
videos.overview: Devki gets emotional after witnessing Krishna's greatness and tells him the story about his birth. Later, Krishna shares a romantic moment with Radha.

videos.title: Radha, Rukmini Take a Vow
videos.overview: When Sukracharya and Saambh conspire to eliminate Krishna, Radha and Balaram sense a danger. Later, Rukmini and Radha promise to protect him.

videos.title: Radha Is Horrified
videos.overview: As Radha hopes to receive an interpretation, Krishna leaves Rukmini's question unanswered. Later, Radha grows shell-shocked to witness an improbable object.

videos.title: Radha Makes a Sacrifice
videos.overview: Radha goes searching for Jara in fear of Krishna's life. On learning about Jara's poverty, Radha sacrifices her ring as a sign of love.

videos.title: Krishna's Words to Jara
videos.overview: As Krishna promises Jara to teach archery, the latter returns him Radha's ring. Jara remains firm in his faith in Krishna, while his wife chastises him.

videos.title: Rukmini to Stop Krishna?
videos.overview: A frantic Radha resolves to stop Krishna from keeping his promise to Jara. She ultimately asks Rukmini to stop him.

videos.title: Radha's Plea to Krishna
videos.overview: Radha pleads with Krishna to stop Rukmini from leaving Dwarka, while he asks her to make a promise. Later, Krishna burns his hands trying to save Radha.

videos.title: Saambh's Cunning Plan
videos.overview: Saambh finds Jara and brings him to Dwarka, knowing that Radha had a premonition of him ending Krishna's life. Meanwhile, Radha tries to warn Krishna.

videos.title: Krishna Shocks Radha
videos.overview: Radha grows elated as Jara takes back his words from Krishna. While Krishna's shocking response hurt Radha, she takes an unusual step to save his life.

videos.title: Krishna Trains Jara
videos.overview: Saambh focuses on making Jara stay back in Dwarka while Krishna trains him. Later, Radha and Krishna start the Navaratri puja by praying to Maa Durga.

videos.title: Saambh Stops Jara
videos.overview: Saambh prevents Jara from leaving Dwarka to fulfill his evil intentions. Later, Jara insists to perform the Shakti Puja with Radha and Krishna.

videos.title: Jara Accomplishes the Task
videos.overview: Jara manages to fulfil his task by collecting the flowers with Radha and Krishna's help. Later, Saambh asks Jara to be Krishna's minister.

videos.title: Maa Durga Blesses Radha
videos.overview: As Jara fails to please Maa Durga, Krishna tries to sacrifice an eye to please the goddess. Maa Durga is pleased by Krishna and blesses Radha.

videos.title: Saambh is Furious!
videos.overview: Saambh is furious that Jara didn't ask for the wish that Saambh had instructed him to ask for. Further, Gurudev takes Saambh to Rishi Durvasa to end Krishna.

videos.title: Saambh's Devious Plan
videos.overview: As Saambh learns Rishi Durvasa's short-tempered nature, he makes a plan to make the latter furious. Meanwhile, Krishna wishes to create a symbol depicting love.

videos.title: Saambh Outwits Durvasa, Krishna
videos.overview: Radha and Krishna complete the monument depicting their love. On the other hand, Saambh attains victory in his sinister plan of tricking Rishi Durvasa.

videos.title: Troubling News For Krishna
videos.overview: Krishna gets worried when he learns that Rishi Durvasa is coming to Dwarka and starts the preparations. Later, Durvasa presents a shocking condition to Krishna.

videos.title: Durvasa's Shocking Revelation
videos.overview: Krishna accepts Durvasa's humiliation with a smile on his face. Later, Durvasa apologises to Radha and Krishna and reveals that he humiliated him to protect him.

videos.title: Worrying News for Durvasa
videos.overview: Durvasa gets concerned when the other Rishis don't arrive at Dwarka before the ceremony. Later, he learns that someone misled them to stop the ceremony.

videos.title: Saambh's Conspiracy Continue
videos.overview: Saambh conspires against Radha as he serves rotten fruits to Durvasa and other Rishis. Later, Krishna comes up with a plan to catch the culprit.

videos.title: Saambh Insults Durvasa
videos.overview: Saambh faces Durvasa and calls the Rishis fraudsters. Meanwhile, Krishna has a plan to handle the situation.

videos.title: Saambh Receives a Curse
videos.overview: Saambh claims that Durvasa and the other sages are all fake as they blessed him with the impossible. Later, Durvasa curses him to give birth from his own body.

videos.title: Radha's Request To Balaram
videos.overview: Jambavati is shocked to learn about the curse Saambh received from Durvasa. Radha requests Balaram to find Saambh and help him when the latter leaves Dwarka.

videos.title: Shukracharya Manipulates Saambh
videos.overview: Shukracharya joins hands with King Shalva in order to destroy Krishna and Balaram. He manipulates Saambh into luring Krishna to danger.

videos.title: Shalva's Devious Plan
videos.overview: Shalva expresses his desire to rule Dwaraka by dethroning Krishna, leading to a scuffle between the two forces. Meanwhile, Radha is concerned about Krishna's absence.

videos.title: Balaram Gets Suspicious
videos.overview: Krishna's clone enters Dwarka and reveals to Balaram that he knows all about Shukracharya and Shalva's plan. However, Balaram gets suspicious about his behaviour.

videos.title: Radha Gets Worried
videos.overview: As Krishna behaves weirdly, Balaram pleads with Radha to keep an eye on him. Eventually, Radha gets bothered when Krishna plays with the feather.

videos.title: Krishna's New Disguise
videos.overview: A disguised Krishna meets King Shalva to gauge how big of a threat he is and the motivation behind him. Later, Balaram questions Kaptasur's battle strategy.

videos.title: Giridhari Traps Kaptasur
videos.overview: As Giridhari supplies milk for the Govardhan Pooja, Radha invites him. Kaptasur gets into a trap while Giridhari wants to listen to Govardhan Katha from him.

videos.title: Kaptasur Manipulates King Shalva
videos.overview: While King Shalva confronts Kaptasur for not fulfilling his duty, the latter manipulates him to get the Pushpavimaan. Later, Radha presents a gift to Krishna.

videos.title: Radha Tests Kaptasur
videos.overview: Radha gets suspicious about Kaptasur when he gloats about his victory and decides to test him. However, Kaptasur comes up with an excuse when he fails the test.

videos.title: Radha Learns the Truth!
videos.overview: Krishna tells Radha that the person who she thought was him was Kaptasur in disguise. Later, Shalva's army reaches Dwarka for the Pushpaka Vimana.

videos.title: Kaptasur's Rude Conduct
videos.overview: Kaptasur hurts Balaram's feelings by misbehaving with him for the loss of the Vimana. However, he agrees with Radha after she admits to give away the Vimana.

videos.title: Kaptasur Gets Stabbed!
videos.overview: Kaptasur sees Radha with Krishna and realises that she knows the truth. Later, he goes to Shalva's kingdom to meet him, but gets stabbed.

videos.title: Krishna Pranks Radha!
videos.overview: Rishi Durvasa brings Kaptasur back to life as Shalva gives him a warning for betraying him. Later, Krishna pretends to be Kaptasur to play a prank on Radha.

videos.title: Krishna Challenges Kaptasur
videos.overview: Kaptasur confronts Krishna and threatens to kill him. After a war of words, Krishna vows to finish himself if Radha chooses Kaptasur over him.

videos.title: Radha Discovers Kaptasur's Plan
videos.overview: After Kaptasur impersonates Krishna, Radha is asked to identify him with her eyes closed. Eventually,Radhadiscovers Kaptasur's nefarious intention.

videos.title: Gopis Invite Krishna
videos.overview: The Gopis invite Krishna and Radha to their villages to perform the Raas. Later, Vidurath receives Mahadev's blessing after offering penance to him.

videos.title: Krishna Challenges Balaram
videos.overview: Balaram accepts Krishna's wrestling challenge. As Krishna partially reveals his motive after losing, Shukracharya makes a deadly deal with Vidhurath.

videos.title: Vidhurath Challenges Krishna
videos.overview: Krishna welcomes Vidhurath to Dwarka, but the latter invites him to a duel to avenge his brother, Dantavakra's death. Krishna accepts his challenge.

videos.title: Shri Krishna Outwits Vidhurath
videos.overview: Shri Krishna outwits Vidhurath by pretending to be tired during their duel while the sun sets. The next morning, Krishna starts the duel.

videos.title: Krishna Eludes Vidhurath
videos.overview: Since the whole world has been made a fighting ring, Krishna eludes Vidhurath and reaches Vrindavan with Radha. Later, Shukracharya assists Vidhurath.

videos.title: Vidhurath Kidnaps the Gopikas
videos.overview: The Gopikas joyously welcome Krishna and Radha to their village. However, Vidhurath kidnaps all of the Gopikas to persuade Krishna to come to their rescue.

videos.title: Krishna Surprises Vidhurath
videos.overview: Krishna arrives where Vidhurath has captured the gopikas and surprises him with his illusion. Awestruck, Vidhurath falls in mud in front of Krishna.

videos.title: Vidhurath Gets Executed!
videos.overview: Vidhurath accepts his loss and requests Krishna to put a stop to their battle. Later, Krishna kills Vidhurath for attempting to harm Radha.
