videos.title: Shukracharya's Evil Plan
videos.overview: Shukracharya furiously determines to wipe out Krishna by taking away the love that has his life. Elsewhere, Krishna anticipates a forthcoming danger.

videos.title: Shukracharya Challenges Nishath
videos.overview: Saambh moans after suffering from a severe stomachache caused by leprosy. Later, Shukracharya infiltrates Nishath's mind to turn him against Krishna.

videos.title: Nishath Gets Provoked
videos.overview: As he resolves to save Nishath, Balaram asks Krishna to look after Saambh. On the other hand, Shukracharya and Shalva instigate Nishath against Krishna.

videos.title: Nishath Puts Forth His Demands
videos.overview: As Shukracharya provokes Nishath, the latter questions Krishna's credibility in Dwarka. Later, Nishath demands Krishna to step down from the throne.

videos.title: Radha to Help Saambh
videos.overview: A mysterious individual gives Jambavati and Radha a potion to save Saambh. Later, Radha fakes an injury to get access to his chamber.

videos.title: Colossal Powers Affect Saambh
videos.overview: Balaram is upset when Krishna refuses his request to be the king for a day. Later, Saambh suffers as supernatural powers erupt from his body.

videos.title: Balaram's Drastic Decision
videos.overview: Balaram feels degraded as Krishna forbids him to be the Dwarkadhish. Out of anger, he decides to master the knowledge by leaving Dwarka.

videos.title: Krishna's Disturbing Anticipation
videos.overview: Balaram decides to acquire knowledge from the sage, unaware of the evil plans. Elsewhere, Krishna's realisation about the forthcoming danger makes him upset.

videos.title: Balaram Gives Assurance
videos.overview: Balaram assures Krishna that his Gurudev will fix the plight raised in Dwarka. While Krishna is upset, Balaram is confident about saving Dwarka.

videos.title: Balaram Foils Romaharshan's Ploy
videos.overview: While Balaram catches Nishad red-handed, Romaharshan carries on the act of doing the Yajna. Later, Balaram foils Romaharshan's ploy.

videos.title: Balram Warns Romharshan
videos.overview: Balram furiously lashes out at Nishath as he tries creating a rift between him and Krishna. Meanwhile, as he tries to teach Romharshan a lesson, Krishna asks Balram to not interrupt the ritual.

videos.title: Romharshan Feels Relieved
videos.overview: As Balram continues to intimidate Romharshan for conspiring against Krishna, the latter convinces Dwaraka to impress Mahadev. Later, Mahadev grants Romharshan a wish.

videos.title: Balaram's Outrageous Act
videos.overview: A furious Balaram attempts to kill Romharshan to stop Mahadeva from offering his boon of indemnity. Later, Krishna convinces them.

videos.title: Krishna Is Helpless
videos.overview: An impotent Balaram breaks down to see Krishna's helplessness towards Romharshan's evil deeds. Elsewhere, Shukracharya celebrates the forthcoming destruction.

videos.title: Balaram Challenges Romharshan
videos.overview: Balaram refuses to let Romharshan leave Dwarka without facing any consequences and challenges him for a fight. Hearing this, Radha worries for him.

videos.title: Saambh's Oath to End Musal
videos.overview: Krishna feels worried about the dangerous and lethal Musal who is in Dwarka. Elsewhere, Saambh pledges to do penance of Mahadev and end Musal.

videos.title: Mahadev's Blessing to Saambh
videos.overview: Krishna explains to Radha the consequences of Saambh's oath to defeat Musal. Later, Mahadev bestows destructive energy on Saambh to fight Musal.

videos.title: Krishna Foils Shukracharya's Plan
videos.overview: Krishna faces a dilemma, but he successfully foils Shukracharya's plan. Furthermore, Saambh has a change of heart as the family reunites.

videos.title: Radha Reassures Saambh
videos.overview: Radha reassures Saambh when Krishna cancels the celebratory festival. Moreover, she promises Saambh that she will convince Krishna to approve the celebration.

videos.title: Mahadev's Anand Tandav
videos.overview: Mahadev and Krishna perform Anand Tandav and Anand Leela respectively. Meanwhile, Shukracharya's spies steal the unholy pestle's fragments.

videos.title: Radha, Krishna Revisit Nidhivan
videos.overview: While Krishna and Radha revisit Nidhivan, he lights up the trees to etch their bond. Meanwhile, Shukracharya orders his troops to smuggle the alien pestle.

videos.title: Krishna Feels Worried
videos.overview: Krishna asks a tensed Samudradev to be calm, but in a state of denial, the latter approaches Mahadev. Meanwhile, Radha feels aloof, but Krishna reassures her.

videos.title: Subhadra Arrives at Dwarka
videos.overview: While the army is getting readied to defend Shalva's attack on Dwarka, Subhadra foresees death. Later, she reaches Dwarka to deliver the vital news to Krishna.

videos.title: Saambh Makes a Sacrifice
videos.overview: Subhadra reveals that she has foreseen Abhimanyu's death at Shalva's hands and asks Krishna to save him. Later, Saambh leaves Krishna shocked with his sacrifice.

videos.title: Saambh Leaves for the War
videos.overview: An undaunted Saambh leaves for war without taking Krishna's blessings. During the fight, Shukracharya asks Shalva to direct all his weapons only towards Saambh.

videos.title: Pradyumna Becomes a Martyr
videos.overview: Pradyumna dies from the impact of Shalva's special weapon. Later Balaram, Nisath and Saambh take an oath of avenging his death.

videos.title: Rukmini Is Devastated
videos.overview: A grief-stricken Rukmini laments the death of Pradyumna after viewing his deceased face. Later, she wailfully questions Krishna about his power.

videos.title: Krishna Decides to Fight!
videos.overview: After an intense and heartfelt conversation, Krishna gets ready for a war against Shalva and his army. However, Radha stays unhappy with Krishna.

videos.title: Radha's Sacrifice for Krishna!
videos.overview: While Krishna defends Saambh, Nishad, and Balaram from Shalva's attack, Radha leaves Dwarka after promising Rukmini. Later, she decides to take her own life.

videos.title: Devaki in Trouble!
videos.overview: While Radha keeps her resolve by not entering the warzone, Krishna puts down his weapons. However, Shalva uses Devaki as a trump card to bring Krishna into the fight.

videos.title: Krishna Feels Powerless
videos.overview: Krishna appears defenceless as Shalva holds Devaki captive. Meanwhile, as Balaram pleads with Radha to join them on the battlefield, Shalva captures Vasudev.

videos.title: End of Vasudev, Devaki?
videos.overview: Devaki and Vasudev get perished on the battlefield by Shalva. Consequently, Shalva faces Radha's wrath as she acquires her power to kill him.

videos.title: Balaram's Shocking Decision
videos.overview: Devastated by the death of Vasudev and Devaki, Balaram decides to break ties with Krishna. Elsewhere, Radha and Rukmini experience a startling event.

videos.title: Radha Leaves Dwaraka
videos.overview: Radha is grateful as Krishna saves Vasudev and Devaki from Shalva's wrath. Meanwhile, to fulfil the promise made to Rukmini, Radha decides to leave Dwaraka.

videos.title: Radha Resurrects Pradyumna
videos.overview: Radha returns to Dwaraka with the power of Goddess Parvati to resuscitate Pradyumna. Later on, Radha declares that Shalva must die at Krishna's hands.

videos.title: Krishna's Final Move
videos.overview: Shalva receives a final warning after Shukracharya rescues him from captivity. Krishna eventually employs the Sudarshana Chakra on Shalva.

videos.title: Balaram to Leave Dwarka
videos.overview: Krishna uses his persuasion skills to convince Balaram to go to Hastinapur and find an end to the drought. Later, Krishna receives a letter from Yashoda.

videos.title: Balram Travels to Vrindavan
videos.overview: Krishna implores Balram to see their mother after receiving an invitation message. Elsewhere, Saambh and Nishath are confronted by a massive lizard-like asura.

videos.title: Radha Grows Restless
videos.overview: Radha conveys her desire to visit Vrindavan, but Krishna pays no heed. While he sleeps peacefully, Radha grows restless.

videos.title: Radha Tricks Krishna
videos.overview: Balram receives a message from Saambh about a gigantic lizard-like creature. Meanwhile, Radha attempts to trick Krishna in order to travel to Vrindavan.

videos.title: Radha Upsets the Gopis
videos.overview: Radha irks the Gopis by doubting their affection for Krishna as they criticise him. Meanwhile, Balram reaches out to protect his sons from a giant monster.

videos.title: Radha Meets Yashoda
videos.overview: Yashoda feels delighted when Radha pays her a surprise visit. Radha later reminisces about her time with Krishna on entering his bedroom.

videos.title: Krishna Comes to Gokul
videos.overview: Krishna tries his best to stop Radha from meeting the Gopis but fails. Later, he arrives at Nand's place, brings down a hanging pot of butter and starts relishing it.

videos.title: Krishna Meets Yashoda
videos.overview: While Krishna steals the butter pot and hides, an evil creature searches for him. Later, Krishna returns to Gokul and meets Yashoda.

videos.title: Yashoda Convinces Krishna
videos.overview: Yashoda persuades Krishna to stay with her for a few more days. Meanwhile, the evil creature successfully escapes from Balram's trap.

videos.title: Krishna's Pranks with the Gopis
videos.overview: Krishna decides to end the conflict between Radha and the Gopis and plays with them. Meanwhile, Yashoda cooks for him the whole night.

videos.title: Krishna's Advice to Balaram
videos.overview: Krishna tricks the Gopis and Yashoda yet again to gain their affection. While Saambh gets annoyed at a sleeping Balaram, Krishna advises the latter.

videos.title: Krishna's New Tactic
videos.overview: Balaram comes to know bout the past birth of the Asur who is in the form of a lizard. Meanwhile, the residents of Vrindavan come to meet an injured Krishna.

videos.title: Krishna Feels Remorse
videos.overview: Krishna repents for his pretention of being injured. Meanwhile, the Asur travels to Vrindavan creating rampage all over.

videos.title: Krishna Gets Caught by Radha
videos.overview: While Krishna tries to escape secretly to face the Asur, Radha catches him red-handed. Meanwhile, Balaram and the boys fail to capture the Asur.

videos.title: Krishna Meets Nrigasur
videos.overview: Krishna somehow manages to escape from his house. Later, he meets Nrigasur and gives him salvation from his lizard form.

videos.title: Balram Is Restricted
videos.overview: Krishna prevents Balram from visiting Vrindavan by promising him something better. Meanwhile, Radha doubts Krishna's behaviour and asks Yashoda to check his room.

videos.title: The Gopis at Krishna's Service
videos.overview: The Gopis take Krishna to a beautiful place to make him happy and shower their love on him. Elsewhere, Banar Rakshas attacks Gokul.

videos.title: Krishna in a Tough Situation
videos.overview: Nand comes up with a smart plan to convince Krishna to hatch some Durlav Pushp. Later, Krishna lands in a fix when Radha and Yashoda request him for the Pushp.

videos.title: Krishna's Secrets Revealed!
videos.overview: Krishna's lies get revealed in front of Yashoda and Radha. Later, he comes up with another mischievous plan to pacify them and win their affection.

videos.title: Radha Feels Guilty
videos.overview: Radha reads Krishna's emotional letter publicly and feels guilty. Meanwhile, another devil approaches Dwarka via the sea route.

videos.title: Krishna's Mischievous Ways
videos.overview: Krishna tricks Radha but she refuses to fall for it. Dau receives Krishna's letter of apology, but doesn't believe his words while danger looms over Dwarka.

videos.title: Krishna Is Challenged
videos.overview: An enormous demon approaches Dwarka, challenging Krishna. Later, Krishna hears of the demon and informs Balram about his onslaught.

videos.title: Balaram Defeats Dwividh
videos.overview: Dwividh continues to create a rampage in Dwarka, looking for Krishna. Later, he tries to abduct the Gopis when Balaram and the boys defeat him.

videos.title: Dwividh Resolves to Retaliate
videos.overview: Dwividh decides to kidnap the Gopiyas to entice Krishna to Dwarka. Balaram eventually learns about Dwividh's initiative to reattack Dwarka.

videos.title: Dwividh Abducts the Gopis
videos.overview: Dwividh attacks once again with his army and kidnaps the Gopis. Later, Krishna gets the message and decides to combat him.

videos.title: Radha Fights Dwividh
videos.overview: Radha battles Dwividh courageously, but he abducts her. Meanwhile, Krishna gets surrounded by Dwividh's soldiers.

videos.title: Krishna Makes Dwividh Collapse
videos.overview: A tired Dwividh falls as he races to catch Krishna. Meanwhile, the Gopis refuse to leave with Balaram till Krishna comes to rescue them.

videos.title: Balaram Executes Dwividh
videos.overview: Dwividh hurls huge rocks at Krishna and the Gopis after threatening him to fight. Later, Balaram kills Dwividh after Krishna's instructions.

videos.title: Krishna's Decision Shocks Radha
videos.overview: Radha is startled by Krishna's revelation after meeting him on the outskirts of Vrindavan. Eventually, Krishna notifies Yashoda that he must return to Dwarka.

videos.title: Krishna Directs Saambh
videos.overview: As Krishna arrives at Dwarka, a few sages approach him regarding Hans and Dimbak's problem. With Krishna's warning, Saambh goes to tackle the situation.

videos.title: Dwellers of Dwarika in trouble
videos.overview: Hans plans to hold marriage for the bachelors of Dwarka and orders to abduct them. Elsewhere, Durbasha calls Balaram and Krishna to tackle the problem of the Brahmins.

videos.title: Radha Puts Her Foot Down
videos.overview: Radha stands as a barrier between the unconsented marriages that Hans is trying to do. Later, Maharishi Durbasha expresses his helplessness to Krishna.

videos.title: Radha Is in a Bind
videos.overview: Hans declares that if Radha agrees to marry him, he will spare all the abducted women. Subsequently, Krishna recommends a personal meeting with Hans.

videos.title: Radha to Marry Hans
videos.overview: Hans sends a gift for Radha and a letter to Krishna to tell him that he wants to marry Radha. Later, Radha agrees to the marriage to save the people of Dwarka.

videos.title: Hans Arrives in Dwarka
videos.overview: While Radha feels guilty about hiding her decision from Krishna, Hans arrives with the prisoners. Later, Radha declares her decision for the people of Dwarka.

videos.title: Hans Faces Disappointment
videos.overview: Hans desires to fulfill Radha's wish of weighing her in gold but gets failed in fulfilling it. However, Radha gives Hans another chance.

videos.title: Hans to Attack Kuber
videos.overview: Hans decides to strike Kuber for his wealth after failing to weigh Radha in gold. Meanwhile, Radha requests Krishna to stay out of her dispute with Hans.

videos.title: Hans Gets Furious
videos.overview: Hans gets perplexed when he cannot weigh gold equal to Radha and thinks it is part of Krishna's deception. Later, he wishes to meet Mahadev.

videos.title: Krishna Erupts in Rage
videos.overview: Hans provokes mayhem after Krishna refuses to give him his ornament. Later, as he kidnaps Radha to marry her forcefully, Krishna gets outraged.

videos.title: Krishna Defeats Hans
videos.overview: Hans reveals the weapons he received from Mahadev as blessings, yet Krishna beats him in the battle. Later, Mahadev takes Hans' defeat as an insult to himself.

videos.title: Krishna Battles Mahadev!
videos.overview: Krishna persuades Mahadev to restore the boon he offered to Dimbak. However, as Mahadev rejects Krishna's suggestion, the two engage in a fierce battle.

videos.title: Krishna Narrates a Story
videos.overview: The downfall of the world starts as Krishna and Shiva clash in battle. Krishna later recounts a story about Mahadev's boon to prove his culpability.

videos.title: Vrikaasur's Wicked Desire
videos.overview: Krishna narrates the story of Vrikaasur seeking Mahadev's blessings. He also mentions a boon that Mahadev bestowed on the demonic Vrikaasur.

videos.title: Vrikaasur Assaults Devlok
videos.overview: The Gods flee to Vaikunth for safety when Vrikaasur attacks Devlok. Later, Shukracharya asks Vrikaasur to take over Vaikunth, but he decides to attack Kailas.

videos.title: Narayan's Plea to Lakshmi
videos.overview: Bhasmasur resolves to invade Narayan's Vaikunth Lok after conquering Kailas Lok. Meanwhile, Narayan requests that Lakshmi bathe in the holy Mansarovar Lake.

videos.title: Bhasmasur Gets Distracted
videos.overview: Narayan finds a solution when Bhasmasur gets fascinated by Lakshmi and Parvati. Upon learning this, an enraged Shukracharya decides to confront Bhasmasur.

videos.title: Mohini Dupes Bhasmasur
videos.overview: Mohini pretends to love Bhasmasur to prevent him from attacking Vaikunth. Later, she confronts the Gods on behalf of Bhasmasur.

videos.title: Mohini's Message to Bhasmasur
videos.overview: Lakshmi gets ready to go to war against Bhasmasur, but Mohini tells her how to avoid it. Later, Mohini delivers a shocking message to Bhasmasur.

videos.title: Mohini to Marry Bhasmasur
videos.overview: Bhasmasur is delighted as Mohini decides to marry him in front of Guru Shukracharya. However, Guru Shukracharya feels suspicious of Mohini's decision.

videos.title: Mohini Faces a Challenge
videos.overview: While Bhasmasur asks to meet with Mohini's family before their wedding, Lakshmi feels confused about Narayan's plan. Later, Mahadev arrives to meet Bhasmasur.

videos.title: Mohini's Real Identity Revealed
videos.overview: Mohini wants her family members to prepare a dance performance for her wedding. Later, Shukracharya informs Bhasmasur about Mohini and her family's real identity.

videos.title: Mohini Ends Bhasmasur
videos.overview: Mohini manipulates Bhasmasur into joining her in dance and makes him touch his head which causes him to turn into ashes. Later, Mahadev apologises to Narayan.

videos.title: Maharishi Bhrigu's Egoistic Action
videos.overview: After the sages ask which of the Trimurtis is the best, Maharishi Bhrigu decides to test them. Meanwhile, Krishna and Radha organise Holi festivities in Dwarka.

videos.title: Lakshmi Punishes Bhrigu
videos.overview: Bhrigu wakes up Narayan from his meditation by stepping on his chest. While Narayan impresses him with his humility, Lakshmi gives Bhrigu a punishment.

videos.title: Bhrigu Upsets Bhargavi
videos.overview: Narayan grants Bhrigu's wish as Lakshmi is born as his daughter and he names her Bhargavi. However, Bhrigu upsets her by not letting her leave the house.

videos.title: Shrinivas Makes a Promise
videos.overview: Bhrigu swears that he will not let Narayan meet Bhargavi, an avatar of Lakshmi. Later, Shrinivas states that he is on the quest for his soulmate.

videos.title: Shrinivas Offers to Dance
videos.overview: Shrinivas decides to dance after sneaking into a women's dancing competition. The princess, however, rejects his proposal because he is not a woman.

videos.title: Enchanting Dance by Shrinivas
videos.overview: Shrinivas begins dancing in front of Natraj without any audience. Meanwhile, as Bhairavi learns about Shrinivas, she feels drawn to him without meeting him.

videos.title: Shrinivas Is Praised
videos.overview: Natraj proclaims Shrinivas to be the greatest dancer in the universe. On the other hand, Shrinivas feels dissatisfied as Bhargavi is not present.

videos.title: Shrinivas Meets Bhargavi
videos.overview: Shrinivas decides to leave Venkatgiri after failing to meet Laxmi. However, as he waits near the ocean, Bhargavi runs into him, fulfilling his wish.

videos.title: Shrinivas and Govindraj Gets Help
videos.overview: Shrinivas suffers injuries on his leg and Govindraj gets irked at his behaviour of avoiding Padmavati's aid. Later, Shrinivas gives up and listens to Padmavati's advices.

videos.title: Shrinivas, Rajkumar's Face-off
videos.overview: As Shrinivas prepares to leave the place, Rajkumar smokes in anger and blames him for taking advantage of his sister. Later, Shrinivas grows anxious to meet his Laxmi.

videos.title: Shrinivas Visits Bhargavi
videos.overview: Shrinivas arrives at Bhargavi's house and wishes to take her with him, with her father's permission. Elsewhere, Padmavati desires to marry Shrinivas.

videos.title: Bhrigu Decides Bhargavi's Fate
videos.overview: Bhrigu finds similarities between Padmavati and Bhargavi's horoscopes. Later, he makes a shocking decision about Bhargavi's marriage.

videos.title: Vasu Doubts Krishna
videos.overview: Rishi Brigu tells Vasu that Padmavati has to wait for three months to marry. Later, Vasu gets suspicious and assumes Krishna's involvement in Rishi Brigu's verdict.

videos.title: Srinivas Impresses Rishi Bhrigu
videos.overview: Padmavati tells Srinivas that if he agrees to teach her dancing, she will say yes to her marriage. Later, Srinivas prepares Payasam for Rishi Bhrigu.

videos.title: Rishi Bhrigu's Desire
videos.overview: To Bhargavi's chagrin, Rishi Bhrigu requests that Shrinivas educate her. He then expresses his desire to get Bhargavi married to Shrinivas.

videos.title: Shrinivas to Impress Bhargavi
videos.overview: To shower love and impress Bhargavi, Shrinivas starts his dance performance. Elsewhere Padmavati waits for Shrinivas for the dance class.

videos.title: Padmavati's Immense Curiosity
videos.overview: Shrinivas agrees to teach Padmavati to see her eagerness. He makes a plan so that she can understand that he does not love her.

videos.title: Kumar Vasudev's Wicked Plan
videos.overview: Infuriated, Kumar Vasudev makes a wicked plan against Shrinivas and tries to imprison him. Elsewhere, Shrinivas gets ready to visit Bhrigu's house to impress Bhargavi.

videos.title: Shrinivas Visits Bhargavi's House
videos.overview: Shrinivas arrives at Bhargavi's house and impresses her family with his culinary skills. Later, Bhargavi induces Shrinivas to admit to sending her flowers.

videos.title: Bhargavi to Annoy Shrinivas
videos.overview: Bhargavi feels irritated at Shrinivas's behaviour and decides to teach him a lesson. Later, when he excels in his task, Bhargavi exhausts out of frustration.

videos.title: Shrinivas Learns Vasudev's Intent
videos.overview: While Shrinivas returns to the palace, he grasps Vasudev's intention against him. Later, to spoil his plan, he takes Padmavati around.

videos.title: Shrinivas Astounds Vasu
videos.overview: Vasu is excited to learn about Shrinivas' misfortune and tries to convey it to Padmavati. Later, Shrinivas shocks him with his appearance.

videos.title: Vasu Collides into Bhargavi
videos.overview: Vasu runs into Bhargavi at the market where she looks for the man who sent her the flowers. Meanwhile, Vasu says that he sent those flowers and decides to visit her home.

videos.title: Vasu Humiliates Shrinivas
videos.overview: Shrinivas feels heartbroken after Vasu humiliates him in front of Bhargavi and Rishi Vrigu. Later, Govindraj grows concerned about Shrinivas when he bursts into tears.

videos.title: Vasudev Reveals Shrinivas' Secret
videos.overview: Padmavati is shocked when Vasudev discloses that Shrinivas works at Rishi Vrigu's house as a cook. Later, Bhargavi goes to meet Shrinivas.

videos.title: Vasu Plans to Impress Bhargavi
videos.overview: Vasu decides to impress Bhargavi with a precious gift and gain control over Rishi Vrigu. Meanwhile, Shrinivas accepts Bhargavi's apology.

videos.title: Padmavati Gets Restless
videos.overview: Padmavati requests her friends to keep their eyes on Bhargavi and Shrinivas. Meanwhile, Bhargavi gets impatient to meet Shrinivas as she wants to impress him.

videos.title: Shrinivas, Bhargavi Become Friends
videos.overview: While Bhargavi is impressed by Shrinivas' story, he convinces her to become his friend. Elsewhere, Padmavati receives false information from her friends.

videos.title: Srinivas Stops Govindaraj
videos.overview: Govindaraj plans to inform Padmavati about Srinivas and Bhargavi's relationship in order to ask her help. However, Srinivas stops Govindaraj from doing so.

videos.title: Bhargavi Thinks of Shrinivas
videos.overview: Bhargavi gets lost in memories of Shrinivas and decides to give him a gift. Elsewhere, Kumar Vasu meets Rishi Vrigu to get in his good books.

videos.title: Bhargavi, Shrinivas Get Closer
videos.overview: Vasu plans on asking Rishi Vrigu for Bhargavi's hand in marriage. Later, Shrinivas and Bhargavi realise that they both bought gifts for each other.

videos.title: Padmavati Comes Across Bhargavi
videos.overview: Bhargavi goes the palace to return Vasu's gift and comes across Padmavati on the way. Elsewhere, Vasu tries to talk about his marriage but gets interrupted.

videos.title: Bhargavi Feels Heartbroken
videos.overview: Bhargavi returns Vasu's present which offends him, but he remains adamant to marry her. Elsewhere, Padmavati gets close with Shrinivas and waits for Bhargavi.

videos.title: Shrinivas Supports Bhargavi
videos.overview: Padmavati talks down to Bhargavi which pushes Shrinivas to take a stand. Later, Padmavati and Bhargavi feel flustered by the challenge that lies ahead.

videos.title: Vasudev to Expose Padmavati
videos.overview: Shrinivas gets worried and helps Bhargavi as she gets her leg injured. Meanwhile, Vasudev plans to expose Padmavati's love for Shrinivas to the king.

videos.title: A Hazard for Shrinivas
videos.overview: Padmavati purposely puts a condition for her swayamvar to marry Shrinivas. Meanwhile, Shrinivas gets restless to learn about Padmavati's condition.

videos.title: Rishi Vrigu's Bad Dream
videos.overview: Shrinivas and Bhargavi feel excited about their union, but Rishi Vrigu's dream causes mayhem. Later, Shrinivas gets to know about Rishi Vrigu's Yagya with Bhargavi.

videos.title: Shrinivas, Bhargavi in a Fix
videos.overview: Shrinivas sees Rishi Vrigu performing a yagya and realises that Mahadev must comply with his disciple's wish. Later, Rishi Vrigu decides to get Bhargavi married.

videos.title: Shrinivas Is Determined
videos.overview: Rishi Vrigu wants to keep away Bhargavi from Narayan, but Shrinivas decides to try his best to marry her. Elsewhere, Bhargavi gets a boon from Mahadev.

videos.title: Rishi Vrigu Makes a Confession
videos.overview: To impress Rishi Vrigu, Vasu presents him with wealth. Later, Rishi Vrigu considers Shrinivas as a suitable competitor for Vasu in Bhargavi's Swayamwar.

videos.title: Rishi Vrigu Gets Impressed
videos.overview: Shrinivas suggests Rishi Vrigu to wait till Padmavati's swayamvar, to find the best groom for Bhargavi. Later, Rishi Vrigu gets impressed by Vasu's behaviour.

videos.title: A Shocker for Shrinivas
videos.overview: Shrinivas is shocked when Vasu tells him that Rishi Vrigu chooses him as Bhargavi's life partener. Later, Bhargavi decides to tell Shrinivas about her feelings.

videos.title: Srinivas, Bhargavi's Reunion!
videos.overview: Srinivas pacifies Bhargavi by leaving his leftover dessert for her to eat and get united. Later, they feel the love between them and get lost in the moment.

videos.title: Padmavati Is Delighted
videos.overview: Padmavati receives a letter bearing Shrinivas' name and feels happy. Meanwhile, Shrinivas makes a plan to prevent Kumar Vasu's evil motive.

videos.title: Bhargavi Becomes Anxious
videos.overview: Bhargavi gets restless to tell Shrinivas about her marriage with Vasu. Elsewhere, Vasu's men keep an eye on Shrinivas.

videos.title: Rishi Vrigu Probes Bhargavi
videos.overview: Shrinivas wants to meet Rishi Vrigu to persuade him about his marriage with Bhargavi. Elsewhere, Rishi Virgu enquires Bhargavi about an incident.

videos.title: Shrinivas Saves Bhargavi, Padmavati
videos.overview: Shrinivas saves Bhargavi by telling Rishi Vrigu about two men leaving his house at night. He further reveals that they were following Padmavati.

videos.title: Shrinivas' Plan Works
videos.overview: Shrinivas is glad that his plan to stop Bhargavi and Vasu's marriage works. Later, as Vasu's secret informers get caught, the Maharaja decides to punish him.

videos.title: Bhargavi's Penalty for Shrinivas
videos.overview: Padmavati confronts Bhargavi and tells her that she has a special connection with Shrinivas. Bhargavi gets suspicious and punishes Shrinivas.

videos.title: Shrinivas' Romantic Gesture
videos.overview: Shrinivas takes Govindraj to the lake to help him collect all the lotuses to present them to Bhargavi. Meanwhile, Padmavati asks Vasudev to do the same.

videos.title: Vasu, Shrinivas in a Conflict
videos.overview: To make Bhargavi happy, Shrinivas collects all the lotuses from a pond and presents them to her. However, Vasu feels Shrinivas is taking away his credit.

videos.title: Rishi Vrigu Questions Shrinivas
videos.overview: Rishi Vrigu gets furious with Shrinivas and questions his intentions with Bhargavi. Later, Vasu visits Rishi Vrigu's house to meet Bhargavi.

videos.title: Shrinivas Convinces Rishi Vrigu
videos.overview: Rishi Vrigu feels convinced by Shrinivas' answer about giving lotuses to Bhargavi. When Vidya wishes to invite Padmavati to her wedding, Bhargavi grows tense.

videos.title: Padmavati's Solemn Promise
videos.overview: After learning about her Swayamvar, Padmavati vows to marry Shrinivas. Later, Bhargavi presents Padmavati with Vidya's wedding invitation.

videos.title: Vidya, Kartik's New Beginning
videos.overview: Padmavati reunites with Bhargavi after realizing that Shrinivas and Bhargavi are not getting married. After Kartik arrives, he maintains a distance from Vidya.

videos.title: Vasu, Padmavati's Sudden Arrival
videos.overview: Vasu and Padmavati decide to attend the Yagya at Rishi Vrigu's house. However, Bhargavi feels upset when she is unable to sit with Shrinivas during the ritual.

videos.title: Shrinivas in a Dilemma
videos.overview: Shrinivas is in a fix when Bhargavi is annoyed, and he tries to mend the situation. Meanwhile, Padmavati tells her friends that the Swayamvar is a fake one.

videos.title: Govindraj Decides to Meet Rajan
videos.overview: While Shrinivas gets disheartened, Govindraj gets tensed for him and decides to meet Rajan. Padmavati confronts Shrinivas and questions about his wedding.

videos.title: Padmavati Finds Shrinivas, Bhargavi
videos.overview: Shrinivas gets worried when Govindraj brings gifts from Padmavati's place. Later, when the former comforts Bhargavi, Padmavati gets envious.

videos.title: Bhargavi Questions Shrinivas
videos.overview: Bhargavi learns about Padmavati's gifts for Shrinivas and questions the latter. Rishi Vrigu receives a message from Ranjan and gets furious at Shrinivas.

videos.title: Rishi Virgu Fumes in Rage
videos.overview: Rishi Vrigu gets furious after he finds Shrinivas' claims of his prediction being wrong. Later, Shrinivas turns nervous when Padmavati tries to convey her love to him.

videos.title: Rishi Vrigu Makes a Decision
videos.overview: Rishi Vrigu gets surprised when Shrinivas points out his miscalculation about Padmavati's swayamvar. Rishi Vrigu decides to examine Shrinivas.

videos.title: Padmavati to Admit Her Feelings?
videos.overview: Srinivas and Bhargavi get romantic when the latter comes to collect flowers at the lake. Later, Srinivas stops her from confessing her feelings for him.

videos.title: Surprising News for Bhargavi
videos.overview: While Bhargavi feels anxious, Shrinivas informs Rishi Vrigu that their marriage will take place the next day. Elsewhere, Padmavati's Swayamvar takes place.

videos.title: Padmavati's Swayamvar Begins
videos.overview: On the day of Padmavati's Swayamvar, Ranjan introduces her to the suitors. Vasu names Shrinivas as the judge for the dance competition of the Swayamvar.

videos.title: Rishi Vrigu Devises a Plan
videos.overview: Rishi Vrigu devises a plan to examine Shrinivas and makes a decision about Bhargavi's wedding. Later, Bhargavi resolves to take a stand for herself.

videos.title: Befitting Reply by Shrinivas
videos.overview: While Vasu insults Shrinivas, the latter gives him an apt reply. Vasu makes a plan and requests Shrinivas to stay in the palace till Padmavati's wedding.

videos.title: Shrinivas' Escape Plan
videos.overview: To break free from the palace, Shrinivas decides to distract the guards. He summons Govindraj and laces the food given to the guards with Bhaang.

videos.title: Bhargivi, Shrinivas Meet Secretly
videos.overview: Shrinivas keeps a daring task before Govindraj in his absence. Later, he meets Bhargivi secretly and conveys to her the difficult situation he faced.

videos.title: Govindraj Is Saved
videos.overview: To save Govindraj from a difficult situation, Shrinivas misleads Padmavati and Vasu. Elsewhere, Rishi Virgu is all set to conduct Vasu and Bhargavi's wedding.

videos.title: Padmavati's Swayamvar Starts
videos.overview: The princes visit Maharaj Akash's palace to participate in Padmavati's Swayamvar. Elsewhere, Bhargavi wishes Shrinivas to prove his excellence before Rishi Vrigu.

videos.title: Shrinivas Is in a Distress
videos.overview: Shrinivas gets upset when things go unexpectedly in the wrong direction, and he fails to control it. Later, he questions Mahadev.

videos.title: Rishi Vrigu's Suggestion
videos.overview: Rishi Vrigu advises Rajan to set up an archery competition to find a perfect match for Padmavati. Shrinivas makes a plan and seeks Govindraj's help.

videos.title: Bhargavi Learns the Truth
videos.overview: Bhargavi gets shocked to learn about Rishi Vrigu's plan for Padmavati's Swayamvar. Later, Rishi Vrigu gets scared and decides to hide Bhargavi from Narayan.

videos.title: Mahadev Narrates the Story
videos.overview: Mahadev shares the story of the most powerful bows in the world, Sharanga and Pinaka. Rishi Vrigu offers prayers to Mahadev in front of the fire to know about Narayan.

videos.title: Rishi Vrigu's Quest for Narayan
videos.overview: Rishi Vrigu, with his divine vision, discovers the presence of Narayan in Venkatgiri. He then decides to protect Bhargavi as long as Narayan is in the palace.

videos.title: Padmavati's Weird Demand
videos.overview: When Rishi Vrigu fails to select a suitable groom for Padmavati, she asks Akash to allow Shrinivas to participate in the Swayamvar. Will Shrinivas agree?

videos.title: Shrinivas Wins the Swayamvar
videos.overview: The detractors of Shrinivas get dumbstruck when he excels in archery and takes Padmavati with him. Rishi Vrigu learns about Narayan's form and fears about Bhargavi.

videos.title: Krishna Reveals His Feelings
videos.overview: Krishna confesses the truth about his love and shares the reasons behind his actions. Meanwhile, Rishi Vrigu gets adamant about conducting Bargavi's wedding.

videos.title: Padmavati's Shocking Experience
videos.overview: Shrinivas reveals himself as the supreme being to Padmavati and finally displays his Swaroop. Later, Rishi Vrigu confronts Rajan with a shocking proposal.

videos.title: Bhargavi Is in Pain
videos.overview: Padmavati returns to the palace and apologises to King Akash for her past deeds. Disappointed Bhargavi wants to know about Shrinivas' love as the wedding comes nearer.

videos.title: Padmavati's Self Sacrifice
videos.overview: Shrinivas comes before Bhargavi and assures her about his love. When Padmavati loses all hope, she gets determined to finish her life.

videos.title: Shrinivas Marries Padmavati
videos.overview: To perform his duty, a disheartened Shrinivas gets married to Padmavati. Bhargavi confesses her love for Shrinivas in her letter and decides to leave Venkatgiri.

videos.title: Shrinivas Confronts Rishi Vrigu
videos.overview: While Bhargavi leaves Venkatgiri, Shrinivas confronts Rishi Vrigu to question the latter's intention. Later, Rishi Vrigu apologises to Shrinivas for his selfish desires.

videos.title: Bhargavi Is Questioned
videos.overview: Bhargavi swears to the Goddess that she will only consider Shrinivas as her husband. Later, some villagers visit the temple and ask Bhargavi about her husband.

videos.title: Rishi Vrigu Is Penalised
videos.overview: Shrinivas is determined to punish the person behind Bhargavi's distress. Rishi Vrigu is aware of Narayan's penalty and gets tensed when King Akash calls him.

videos.title: Rishi Vrigu Receives an Ultimatum
videos.overview: Akash holds Rishi Vrigu responsible for the outcomes and wants everything fixed before sunset. When Shrinivas sticks to his decision, Rishi Vrigu faces hardships.

videos.title: Rishi Vrigu Grows Anxious
videos.overview: Kumar Vasu faces Rishi Vrigu's wrath when he wants to find Bhargavi to punish her. On the other hand, Rishi Vrigu gets shocked to see Vidya's ruined wedding hall.

videos.title: Shrinivas' Shocking Condition
videos.overview: Shrinivas makes a condition for Padmavati when the latter is determined to do anything to please Shrinivas. Bhargavi gets restless to see the corruption in Uma's village.

videos.title: Bhargavi Learns about Uma
videos.overview: Govindraj informs Rishi Vrigu that Padmavati and Vasu are searching for Bhargavi. When Bhargavi gets hurt by Uma's behaviour, the latter comes to tell the truth.

videos.title: Bhargavi Takes an Oath
videos.overview: Bhargavi vows to Narayan that she will reunite Gauri and Shankar. Later, Padmavati makes a request to Shrinivas about their marital relationship.

videos.title: Bhargavi Convinces Aai
videos.overview: Bhargavi reaches Aai's home and convinces the latter to agree to Gauri and Shankar's wedding. Later, Bhargavi gets lost in Shrinivas' thoughts.

videos.title: Aai Ridicules Shankar
videos.overview: Padmavati is delighted as Shrinivas takes her on a trip. Meanwhile, after seeing Shankar's strange attire, Aai disapproves of Gauri marrying him.

videos.title: Mahadev Helps Shankar
videos.overview: As Shankar walks around the forest feeling defeated, Mahadev appears in a guise of a hermit and guides him. Shankar gets heavily compensated for helping Vasu.

videos.title: Bhargavi's Valiant Efforts
videos.overview: Bhargavi resolves to end Gauri's forced marriage to Alok and seeks help from Narayan. In the meantime, Vasu deceives Shankar in order to reach Bhargavi.

videos.title: A Shocker for Kumar Vasu
videos.overview: Kumar Vasu gets shocked to learn about Bhargavi's feelings for Shrinivas. Later, he informs Bhargavi about Shrinivas and Padmavati's marriage to take his revenge.

videos.title: Bhargavi Feels Shattered
videos.overview: Bhargavi feels miserable when Vasu tells her that Shrinivas is not worthy of her love. She loses her senses but wakes up to Shrinivas making her a promise.

videos.title: Kumar Vasu's Vicious Plan
videos.overview: Padmavati tells Shrinivas that he should stay with her until there is some news of Bhargavi. Kumar Vasu makes a vile plan to prevent Shrinivas from meeting Bhargavi.

videos.title: Shrinivas to Locate Bhargavi?
videos.overview: Govindraj learns of Bhargavi's exact location and informs Shrinivas. However, Padmavati becomes concerned and demands proof of Bhargavi's whereabouts.

videos.title: Rishi Bhrigu Reveals the Truth
videos.overview: Akash gets shocked when Rishi Bhrigu discloses the truth about Shrinivas' real identity. Rishi Bhrigu seeks Mahadev's help to prevent Shrinivas from meeting Bhargavi.

videos.title: Mahadev, Kanyakumari's Tale
videos.overview: To stop Shrinivas from marrying Bhargavi, Shukracharya reminds Mahadev of his past with Kanyakumari. Later, Mahadev tells the tale of Kanyakumari.

videos.title: Mahadev Restricts Shrinivas
videos.overview: Mahadev decides to locate Shrinivas and prevent him from meeting Bhargavi while Vasu devises a plan to kidnap Uma.

videos.title: Bhargavi Becomes Agitated
videos.overview: Shrinivas refuses to accept Mahadev's staggering condition. As a result, Bhargavi becomes distressed since Shrinivas failed to reach her before sunset.

videos.title: Shrinivas Gets Desperate
videos.overview: Vasu instructs Aai to look after Bhargavi and keep her away from Shrinivas. Later, a desperate Shrinivas arrives at Aai's house to persuade Bhargavi.

videos.title: Bhargavi Ignores Shrinivas
videos.overview: Upon Aai's request, Bhargavi refuses to meet Shrinivas. Later, Lord Mahadev assures Gauri that Shrinivas will find a way to meet Bhargavi.

videos.title: Shrinivas Seeks Govindraj's Help
videos.overview: Bhargavi declines Kumar Vasu's invitation to attend the Gokul Ashtami celebrations. Thereupon, Shrinivas convinces Govindraj to help him meet Bhargavi.

videos.title: Shrinivas' Epic Plan
videos.overview: Shrinivas devises a plan with Govindraj, and they disguise themselves as a married couple to meet Bhargavi. Later, Shrinivas finds a way to visit Karveerpur.

videos.title: Shrinivas Visits Karveerpur
videos.overview: Shrinivas and Govindraj wear disguises and arrive at Karveerpur with butter for the Janmashtami celebration. When Kumar Vasu seeks their help, Shrinivas gives a condition.

videos.title: Shrinivas Celebrates Dahi Handi
videos.overview: Shrinivas resolves to engage in the Dahi Handi celebration as Vasu fails to break the pot. After noticing Bhargavi leave the festivity, he slips while climbing.

videos.title: Bhargavi Worries for Shrinivas
videos.overview: After Bhargavi shows trust in him, Shrinivas, disguised as Venkatesh, breaks the earthen pot. After the pyramid collapses, Bhargavi rushes to his aid.

videos.title: Srinivas Helps Bhargavi
videos.overview: Srinivas tells Govindaraj that Bhargavi needs to love herself first before she can truly love him. Later, Srinivas finds Bhargavi in pain at the lake and helps her.

videos.title: Shrinivas' Mischievous Act
videos.overview: Shrinivas steals Bhargavi's clothes while she is bathing in the river. When Govindraj gets worried, he climbs a tree and returns the clothes.

videos.title: Kumar Vasu Gets Agitated
videos.overview: Kumar Vasu gets furious to see Bhargavi's concern when she questions him about Shrinivas' whereabouts. Later, Aai plans to help Kumar Vasu keep Bhargavi distracted.

videos.title: Padmavati Announces a Competition
videos.overview: Padmavati meets Bhargavi and asks her to participate in the dance competition. When Bhargavi gets challenged, Shrinivas urges her to take part.

videos.title: Kumar Vasu Devises a Plan
videos.overview: Kumar Vasu makes a devious plan against Bhargavi to take revenge for his humiliation. Shrinivas decides to help Bhargavi to gain self-confidence when she feels dejected.

videos.title: Shrinivas Comforts Bhargavi
videos.overview: Shrinivas tries to boost Bhargavi's confidence when she decides to withdraw her name from the competition. Will Bhargavi regain her confidence?

videos.title: A Shocker for Bhargavi
videos.overview: Mahadev disguises himself to confront Kumar Vasu and reveals the name of the guy who stole Bhargavi's clothes. Soon, Bhargavi receives shocking news about Venkatesh.

videos.title: Venkatesh Accepts His Fault
videos.overview: Venkatesh accepts his mistake when Bhargavi confronts him about his notorious actions. However, he claims that he had no evil intentions toward her.

videos.title: Venkatesh's Promise to Bhargavi
videos.overview: Kumar Vasu orders Padmavati to lose in the dancing competition. Elsewhere, Venkatesh accepts Bhargavi's request and promises to bring Shrinivas to the contest.

videos.title: Shrinivas Discovers Vasu's Evil Plan
videos.overview: Venkatesh promises Padmavati that he will bring Shrinivas to the dance contest. Furthermore, Shrinivas learns of Vasu's evil plot against Padmavati.

videos.title: Shrinivas to Judge the Competition
videos.overview: Shrinivas surprises Bhargavi and Padmavati with his sudden arrival. Bhargavi and Padmavati choose to make Shrinivas the judge of the competition.

videos.title: Bhargavi Rejects Vasu
videos.overview: Vasu forces Bhargavi to marry him after she wins the competition, but she refuses his proposal. Later, he decides to teach Venkatesh a lesson for manipulating Bhargavi.

videos.title: Vasu Gets Manipulated
videos.overview: Kumar Vasu gets influenced by Bharya, who asks him to put Venkatesh and Shrinivas on the death row. Vasu then visits Shukracharya following Bharya's request.

videos.title: Kohlasur Has Risen
videos.overview: Shukracharya awakens Kohlasur to take revenge on Vishnu after several years. Elsewhere, Raja Akash meets Padmavati, and Bhargavi meets her parents.

videos.title: Kohlasur Declares War
videos.overview: Kohlasur warns Kumar Vasu from ordering him when the latter tells him to kill everyone. After Shrinivas and Venkatesh appear in front of him, he declares war on them.

videos.title: Mahalaxmi's Devi Ambabai Form
videos.overview: Bhargavi comes before Kohlasur and wants to teach him a lesson for his heinous conduct. She acquires Mahalaxmi's powers and annihilates him in Ambabai's form.

videos.title: Shrinivas Displays His Swaroop
videos.overview: Shrinivas reveals the truth in front of everyone and displays his Swaroop. Rishi Vrigu apologises to Shrinivas for his previous deeds and requests him to marry Bhargavi.

videos.title: Krishna's Pledge to Radha
videos.overview: Krishna makes a promise to Radha and announces to celebrate Navaratri to empower the women in the world. Later, he invites all the Devtas to Dwarka.

videos.title: Krishna's Exceptional Plan
videos.overview: To make Navaratri special, Krishna plans something exceptional for women. Later, Radha feels dejected when Balaram and Saambh make a blunder in Krishna's plan.

videos.title: Radha Feels Dejected
videos.overview: Radha gets disheartened to think about the questions Krishna will face in the future for not marrying her. Elsewhere, Shukracharya devises a devious plan against Krishna.

videos.title: Shukracharya Awakens Apasmar
videos.overview: Krishna makes Mahadev take his Nataraj avatar so that all the wives who see him can feel Mahabhava. Later, Shukracharya wakes up Apasmar, who can erase memories.

videos.title: Shukracharya's Evil Instruction
videos.overview: Krishna tells Parvati's story of how Apasmar treated her. Shukracharya instructs Apasmar to snatch women's memories and make them unwise.

videos.title: Radha's Decision Upsets Krishna
videos.overview: Apasmar casts his spell on the women and eliminates the positive vibes from them. Krishna gets bothered by Radha's decision to not attend Mahadev's Anand Nritya.

videos.title: Krishna's Strategy Against Apasmar
videos.overview: While Apasmar visits Kailash to obstruct Mahadev's Anand Nritya, Krishna tricks Apasmar to thwart his plan. Radha gets furious to see Krishna's behaviour toward Subhadra.

videos.title: Radha Gets Furious
videos.overview: Angry, Radha questions Krishna's intention for ignoring a drowning Subhadra. Elsewhere, Shukracharya learns the exact location of Mahadev.

videos.title: Krishna Takes a Decision
videos.overview: An anxious Balaram informs Krishna about Apasmar's visit to Kailash. Afterwards, Krishna decides to gratify Radha by narrating the story of Trijata.

videos.title: Parvati Warns Apasmar
videos.overview: While Apasmar attempts to stop Mahadev's Ananda Nritya, Parvati furiously warns Apasmar. Later, Mahadev fumes in anger when Apasmar attacks him to prevent his dance.

videos.title: Krishna to Convince Apasmar
videos.overview: Apasmar feels victorious as Parvati, Radha and other females turn into the victims of his majestic power. Krishna confronts Apasmar in an effort to make him understand.

videos.title: Mahadev's Rudra Tandav!
videos.overview: Furious, Mahadev starts Rudra Tandav and throws an open challenge to Apasmar when he boasts of his devil powers. Apasmar grasps super strength from the devils to overcome Mahadev.

videos.title: Krishna Knits a Plan
videos.overview: Saambh informs Krishna and Balaram about the women who left the palace due to Apasmar's power. Krishna designs a plan to locate them and gives his flute to Balaram.

videos.title: Mahadev Fumes in Anger
videos.overview: Shukracharya seeks Rahu and Ketu's help to prevent Balaram and Saambh to find out Radha. Elsewhere, Krishna grows anxious when Mahadev furiously decides to kill Apasmar.

videos.title: Parvati Takes a Decision
videos.overview: Parvati decides to create another world only for the women to stay away from men. Krishna narrates Rahu and Ketu's involvement in Radha-Krishna's eternal love story.

videos.title: Krishna Narrates Samudra Manthan
videos.overview: Krishna describes to Balaram why he and Radha never got united. He recounts the incident of Samudra Manthan and Swarbhanu's intent to get the Amrit.

videos.title: Samudra Manthan Takes Place
videos.overview: Krishna explains how the Asurs and Devtas took part in the Samudra Manthan. The Asurs grabbed Vasuki's head, and the Devtas held the tail. Swarbhanu urges Shukracharya to stop it.

videos.title: Mahadev's Great Sacrifice
videos.overview: Mahadev drinks the poisonous Halahal during the Samudra Manthan to save the Asurs and the Devtas. Later, Mohini entices the Asurs and the Devtas with her charm.

videos.title: Krishna Briefs the Reason
videos.overview: Krishna tells everyone that the Kaal Sarpa Dosha is why he and Radha remain separated. Mahadev's Tandav Nritya brings the realisation of love in Radha and Parvati.

videos.title: Krishna Searches for Radha
videos.overview: Parvati urges theÂ women to sense the love of their husbands after she feels guilty forÂ misinterpreting Mahadev.Â Krishna gets determined to find Radha and other females.

videos.title: Rahu, Ketu's Evil Move
videos.overview: To keep Radha away from Krishna, Rahu and Ketu use their powers to send Radha far away, so that the couple can never meet. Can Krishna overcome this setback?

videos.title: Krishna Faces Rahu and Ketu
videos.overview: Despite Saambh's refusal, Krishna sends him away. Moreover, he asks Balaram to leave since this is a battle that he must fight by himself.

videos.title: Radha Sees the Future
videos.overview: Radha forsees the Ardh-Nareshwar Avatar and realises that it is she and Krishna. The Devtas feel elated about this Mahabhaav, which infuriates Rahu and Ketu.

videos.title: Parvati Receives Radha's Invite
videos.overview: Devi Parvati becomes ecstatic after receiving Radha's invite to celebrate Vijayadashami in Dwarka. Later, Radha and Krishna welcome Mahadev and Parvati to Dwarka.

videos.title: Shankhachur Visits Dwarka
videos.overview: Shankhachur comes to Dwarka for the Havaan as he wishes to meet Radha and garner her praises. However, when Radha ignores him and meets Krishna, Shankhachur gets irked.

videos.title: Balaram Grows Agitated
videos.overview: Balaram gets infuriated after learning about Shankhachur's behaviour towards Revati. Elsewhere, Damini advises Shankhachur to meet Shukracharya to ploy against Krishna.

videos.title: Shankhachur Abducts the Gopis
videos.overview: Parvati prepares to welcome Radha and Krishna in the Golok. Meanwhile, an infuriated Shankhachur kidnaps the Gopis after they belittle him.

videos.title: Parvati Grows Anxious
videos.overview: Mahadev comforts Parvati when she gets worried thinking about Krishna's intention. Elsewhere, Krishna gets furious when Shankhachur forces the Gopis to marry him.

videos.title: Radha to Save the Gopis!
videos.overview: Krishna teaches a lesson to Shankhachur as he tries to attack the Gopis. Radha decides to convince Shankhachur of her love to free the Gopis from his trap

videos.title: Shukracharya Advises Shankhachur
videos.overview: Shukracharya instructs Shankhachur to give a specific condition to Radha when he meets with her. Later, Balaram gets furious at Krishna for not looking for Shankhachur.

videos.title: Krishna Gets Blamed
videos.overview: When Shankhachur takes Radha with him to fulfil his ill intentions, Krishna gets accused of letting her go. Later, Krishna reveals his plan to Balaram.

videos.title: The End of Shankhachur
videos.overview: Krishna reaches Shankhachur's place and puts an end to the latter's life for his misdeeds. Later, Radha and Krishna get engaged in the Rasleela along with the Gopis.

videos.title: Shukracharya's Devious Motive!
videos.overview: To bring an end to mankind, Shukracharya invites the power of Asuras. Fearing the inevitable destruction, Krishna decides to act against Shukracharya.

videos.title: Krodhasur Spreads Rage
videos.overview: Shukacharya invocates Shadaripu to destroy humanity, and then the latter calls out Krodhasur. Later, Krodhasur visits Dwarka to spread rage and bring about Krishna's end.

videos.title: Lobhasur's Evil Motive
videos.overview: Due to Krodhasur's act, Balaram faces the people of Dwarka's rage. Shadripu invokes Lobhasur, who manipulates Saambh against Balaram.

videos.title: Mohasur Misleads Rukmini
videos.overview: Mohasur misleads Rukmini into believing that Radha is Krishna's priority. Elsewhere, Sukracharya decides to spread negativity and darkness in Dwarka.

videos.title: Krishna Confronts Shadripu
videos.overview: Krishna decides to confront Shadripu when darkness descends on Dwarka. Later, Krishna gives a shocking sanction to Shadripu.

videos.title: Krishna Explains to Radha
videos.overview: Radha gets puzzled when everyone lashes out at her for asking about Krishna's whereabouts. Later, Krishna informs Radha about Krodhasur's control over everyone.

videos.title: Krishna's Tale of Ram Rajya
videos.overview: Krishna talks about Ram Rajya and the significance of Deepavali. Krishna then defeats all the Asurs by chanting Lord Ram's name and peace returns to Dwarka.

videos.title: Radha Takes a Decision
videos.overview: Krishna asks Rishi Garga to write Garga Sanhita based on Radha and Krishna's Prem-Bhakti Ras. Radha decides to make Rishi Garga witness her and Krishna's love story.

videos.title: Radha, Krishna to Relive the Past
videos.overview: Krishna lives in Vrindavan and Radha in Varsana to experience the love of their past. Radha can feel Krishna's presence and gets excited to meet him.

videos.title: Krishna Devises a Plan
videos.overview: Krishna gets restless to meet Radha and he makes a plan to visit Barsana along with Balaram. Later, Radha gets furious and gives a firm condition to her Sakhis.

videos.title: Krishna Disguised Himself
videos.overview: Krishna disguises himself as Gopadevi and visits Barsana along with Balaram to meet with Radha before the half-moon. Radha gets mesmerised when Krishna plays the Veena for her

videos.title: Kansa to Meet with Bakasur?
videos.overview: With the energy of Radha and Krishna's love, a dormant demon, Bakasur awakes and decides to meet Kansa. Kansa takes an oath after learning about Krishna's survival.

videos.title: Krishna Makes Radha Furious
videos.overview: Radha fumes in rage as Krishna makes fun of her attire and appearance. Later, Bakasur keenly searches for Krishna to seek revenge for Putana's death.

videos.title: Krishna's Gopadevi Form
videos.overview: Radha sends Krishna a letter, asking him to visit her. However, she identifies him when he arrives to meet her in the guise of Gopadevi.

videos.title: Radha and Krishna Meet
videos.overview: According to Radha's promise, she and Krishna meet on a half-moon night. On the other hand, Bakasur finally sees Balaram and gets proof that Krishna is alive.

videos.title: Balaram to Save Barsana
videos.overview: Bakasur creates a terrible storm in Barsana. While Balaram confronts Bakasur, Vrishabhanu gets worried about the demon and decides to move Vrindavan.

videos.title: Radha Visits Vrindavan
videos.overview: Radha gets overjoyed when Krishna welcomes her in Vrindavan. Elsewhere, after being defeated by Balaram, a furious Bakasur seeks permission from Kans to kill Krishna.

videos.title: A Surprise for Radha
videos.overview: Krishna surprises Radha as he reveals a romantic gift for her. Later, Kans threatens Bakasur, making him find a ray of hope in tracing Krishna.

videos.title: Krishna Fights Bakasur
videos.overview: Krishna dodges the ball that Radha throws with all her might, knocking Bakasur out. Later, Krishna and Bakasur engage in a fierce battle.

videos.title: Radha Stops Krishna
videos.overview: Krishna gets furious when Bakasur returns to Vrindavan, and he prepares to destroy him. However, Radha stops Krishna because she doesn't want to lose him again.

videos.title: Krishna's Condition for Radha
videos.overview: Krishna promises to not attach himself to Bakasur under the condition that Radha won't attack him. Later, Krishna goes to Bakasur who swallows him alive in front of Radha.

videos.title: Bhadrakali to Defeat Bakasur
videos.overview: Parvati comes before Bakasur in the form of Bhadrakali and decides to kill him after his heinous acts. Later, Radha grows anxious and frees Krishna from her oath.

videos.title: Krishna Defeats Bakasur
videos.overview: Radha frees Krishna from his oath, and the latter defeats Bakasur, releasing Prince Utkal from his curse. Later, Krishna uses the Ashta Sakhas to envy Radha.

videos.title: Kans Fumes in Anger
videos.overview: Radha gets jealous of her sakhis when Krishna promises to take them on a tour. Meanwhile, Kansa gets infuriated as Akrur informs him about Bakasur's death.

videos.title: Kansa Takes an Oath
videos.overview: Krishna plans a surprise for Radha and arranges a special festival in Vrindavan. Kansa gets furious and swears not to meet Jarasandha until he kills Krishna.

videos.title: Asti Makes a Firm Decision
videos.overview: Asti decides to stop Kansa from committing another sin and asks Akrur's help to meet Krishna. Later, Krishna gets shocked to learn about Ashta Sakhi's decision.

videos.title: Radha's Special Announcement
videos.overview: Prapti advises Kansa to get in touch with demons who are more powerful than Bakasur. Radha decides to make arrangements for the Maha Raas festival in Vrindavan.

videos.title: Radha's Shocking Condition
videos.overview: Mahadev and Parvati eagerly wait to attend the Maha Raas Utsav in Vrindavan. When Radha learns about Krishna's tricks, she puts forth a condition to him.

videos.title: Radha, Krishna's Raas Leela
videos.overview: Krishna meets Mahadev and devises a plan to keep up his promise to Radha. Later, the residents of Vrindavan enjoy the special Raas-Leela celebrations.

videos.title: Lakshmi-Narayan's Swaroop
videos.overview: Krishna and Radha reveal their real Swaroop to the Ashta Sakhis. Later, Radha is shocked to see the changes in Ashta Sakhis' behavior towards her.

videos.title: Kansa to Meet Aristasura
videos.overview: Yashoda and Kirtida are shocked to witness the Ashta Sakhis' behaviour towards them. Upon Akrur's advice, Kansa decides to meet Aristasura and kill Krishna.

videos.title: Radha to Impress Yashoda
videos.overview: Radha is concerned that the Gopis have discovered her and Krishna's true identity. Later, she convinces the Gopis to look after Yashoda in order to impress her.

videos.title: Kans Sends a Bison
videos.overview: The residents of Vrindavan are glad when Kans sends them a black Bison for protection. In the meantime, Krishna, Balaram and Radha's suspicions grow.

videos.title: The Birth of Demon Aristhasur
videos.overview: Mahadev tells Devi Parvati how Sage Vartantu was cursed and turned into the demon Aristhasur. Parvati is worried about the consequences of Aristhasur in Vrindavan.

videos.title: Asthi in Grave Trouble
videos.overview: Despite Radha's refusal, Balaram feels enraged at Aristhasur and decides to warn him. Elsewhere, Kans coerces Asthi into performing a Yagya against Krishna.

videos.title: Krishna Takes Accountability
videos.overview: Nand Baba commands Balaram leave Vrindavan and go on an exile. However, Krishna takes the blame and bids goodbye to everyone as Radha joins him.

videos.title: Radha, Krishna Go on an Exile
videos.overview: Radha and Krishna depart from Vrindavan as they go on an exile together. Later, Krishna builds a hut amidst the woods and spends time with Radha.

videos.title: Arishtasura Unveils His Identity
videos.overview: The residents of Vrindavan panic as the black bison turns out to be Arishtasura. Deceiving him, Balaram leads Arishtasura to Krishna's habitat.

videos.title: Arishtasura Seeks Forgiveness
videos.overview: After Krishna frees him from his curse, Arishtasura begs for forgiveness as he realises his mistake. Later, Krishna asks Balaram to return to Vrindavan.

videos.title: Nanda Apologises to Krishna
videos.overview: Balaram tells Nanda and the people of Vrindavan that Krishna won't return until they realise their mistake. Later, Nanda apologises to Krishna for punishing him.

videos.title: Krishna's Lesson to Vrindavanbasis
videos.overview: Krishna gives a valuable lesson to Vrindavanbasis as they realise their mistakes. Meanwhile, the Devtas hail Vrindavan for its beauty, leaving Brahma furious.

videos.title: Brahma Dev Confronts Krishna
videos.overview: An enraged Brahma Dev vows to confront Krishna and ask him to tell Radha to take her words back. Elsewhere, Yashoda feels happy to learn that Radha likes Krishna.

videos.title: Brahma Dev in Disguise
videos.overview: Taking a guise of a sage, Brahma Dev visits Vrindavan to prove his statement. Later, he hatches a plan and tries to manipulate the Sakhis against Krishna.

videos.title: Radha Gets Disheartened
videos.overview: Radha is in shock learning of Krishna's move to change Yashoda's decision about his marriage with Radha. Elsewhere, Brahma Dev abolishes the Sakhis of Vrindavan.

videos.title: Yashoda's Shocking Condition
videos.overview: Yashoda furiously gives a shocking condition to Krishna when all the sakhis get abolished from Vrindavan. Balaram is shocked to learn about Brahma Dev's vile plan.

videos.title: Radha in a Bind
videos.overview: While Yashoda is concerned about her demand, Radha is unsure how to fulfil Yashoda's wish. Meanwhile, Brahma Dev plots to derail Radha's plan.

videos.title: Kans Summons Agasura
videos.overview: Brahma Dev apologises to Radha for his arrogance after realising the mistake. On the other hand, Kans summons an enormous serpent named Agasura to kill Krishna.

videos.title: Agasur Poisons the Kheer
videos.overview: Krishna welcomes the Vrindavanbasis and convinces Kritika to eat the Kheer. Agasur gets determined to kill Krishna so arrives at Vrindavan and poisons the Kheer.

videos.title: Kirtida Makes an Announcement
videos.overview: Kirtida is disappointed as Krishna ignores her in front of everyone. Krishna convinces Kirtida with his tricks and she announces her consent to Radha's marriage with him.

videos.title: Agasura's Villainous Decision
videos.overview: Agasura confronts Kans and promises to kill Krishna on the day of his wedding. Later, Radha feels dejected when Krishna asks her to rethink about their marriage.

videos.title: Krishna Is in a Tough Spot
videos.overview: Agasura hatches a plan and creates a huge mountain in front of the Vishnu temple. Krishna grows anxious as Balaram requests him to inform his parents about his decision.

videos.title: Krishna, Radha's Wedding Prep
videos.overview: Krishna gets into his childhood, to fulfil Radha's wish. Radha summons the Devtas and asks them to conduct her and Krishna's wedding at the auspicious moment.

videos.title: Krishna Weds Radha
videos.overview: Radha and Krishna take part in the wedding rituals in the presence of the Devi and Devtas. After their marriage, Krishna puts a tough question before Radha.

videos.title: Radha, Krishna's Sacrifice
videos.overview: Radha and Krishna decide to eliminate the memory of their wedding from the minds of their dear ones. While the people of Vrindavan visit the Vishnu mandir, Agasur plans to kill Krishna.

videos.title: Krishna's Joyful Moment
videos.overview: Krishna spends a cheerful moment with Radha, Balaram, and the Ashta Sakhis. Later, Balaram is shocked to discover Lalita and Vishakha entering a terrible cave.

videos.title: Krishna to the Rescue
videos.overview: Krishna requests Agasura to release the people of Vrindavan from his captivity. Agasura agrees but asks Krishna to become his meal in exchange.

videos.title: Radha Feels Disheartened
videos.overview: Radha gets disheartened when Vrishbhanu and Kirtida decide to return to Barsana. Kans makes a decision to meet with Narada to ask for a suitable way to kill Krishna.

videos.title: Indra Dev's Bizarre Demand
videos.overview: To trouble the Vrindavanbasis, Indra Dev keeps weird desires before them for his Pooja. Radha feels disheartened about leaving Vrindavan and Krishna.

videos.title: Mahadev's Advice for Narad
videos.overview: Mahadev asks Narad to fulfil Indradev's wish and to deliver his message to Kans. Elsewhere, the Vrindavanbasi begin the ritual according to Indradev's demand.

videos.title: Devraj Indra Gets Furious
videos.overview: Devraj Indra gets furious as the Vrindravanbasi refuse to fulfil his unwanted demands. He furiously teams up with Kans to punish the Vrindavanbasi and take his revenge.

videos.title: Vrindavan Faces Indra Dev's Wrath
videos.overview: The Vrindavanbasi get into trouble when the entire Vrindavan floods due to heavy rainfall. Indra Dev decides to take revenge for the dishonour he faces in Vrindavan.

videos.title: Krishna to Rescue Vrindavanbasi
videos.overview: Krishna decides to shift Vrindavanbasi to Govardhan Parvat to save them from Indra Dev. However, they get scared and question Krishna's decision.

videos.title: Krishna's Govardhan Leela
videos.overview: Krishna lifts the Govardhan hill to protect the Vrindavan from the terrible rain and thunderstorms. Elsewhere, Kans gets furious and summons Indra Dev.

videos.title: Vrindavan Faces an Outrage
videos.overview: The Vrindavan people face a sudden calamity due to Indra Dev's terrifying rage. Later, Akrur gets astonished to see Krishna's Govardhan Leela and apologises to him.

videos.title: Indra Dev's Apology
videos.overview: Indra Dev realises his mistake to fight against Krishna and apologises to the latter. Kans gets infuriated when Akrur advises him to change his decision to kill Krishna.

videos.title: Radha Bids Farewell!
videos.overview: When Krishna asks Radha to leave, she is concerned that she has failed despite her best efforts. Later, Radha bids everyone a tearful goodbye.

videos.title: Krishna Brings Radha Back
videos.overview: Radha is surprised to see Krishna and he wishes to bring her back to Dwarka. Later, Krishna informs Radha about the Garg-Samhita.

videos.title: Radha, Krishna in a Pickle
videos.overview: Radha gets intrigued by the prospect of visiting Golok and requests that Krishna prepare for it. Meanwhile, Saambh and the others request Krishna for a celebration.

videos.title: Krishna in a Tough Spot
videos.overview: Radha gets shattered after learning about Krishna's fate regarding his death. Later, Krishna gets into a dilemma when Radha asks for a promise.

videos.title: Akrur Brings Gifts for Krishna
videos.overview: Krishna hinders Akrur's attempts to hunt a deer to gift the former. Later, while Akrur visits Krishna with the special gift, Radha fears Krishna's death.

videos.title: Krishna Advises the Dwarkabasis
videos.overview: Krishna advises the Dwarkabasis to remain united under all circumstances and enjoy the moment. Saambh gets attracted to Jara's arrow and is determined to have it.

videos.title: Mahadev Reveals a Story
videos.overview: While Parvati grows anxious, Mahadev reveals the story behind the fate of Krishna's death. Later, Jara accuses Saambh of stealing his arrow and a conflict ensues.

videos.title: Radha-Krishna Share a Moment
videos.overview: Radha and Krishna spend their last moments together before Radha's heartbreaking goodbye. Elsewhere, Jara and Saambh hatch a plan for each other to take revenge.

videos.title: Saambh Gets Punished
videos.overview: Krishna gets disheartened and refuses to play the flute as Radha departs for Golok. Krishna announces the punishment for Saambh for stealing Jara's arrow.

videos.title: Radha Returns to Golok
videos.overview: Radha completes her life on earth abiding by the curse of Shreedama and returns to Golok. Elsewhere, Jara feels dejected as Krishna does not accept his gift.

videos.title: Saambh Makes a Profound Vow
videos.overview: Saambh expresses regret for his behaviour and vows restraint toward Lakshmana. However, Jara's attempt to approach Krishna enrages Saambh again.

videos.title: Krishna's Last Meeting
videos.overview: Rukmini breaks down in tears and asks Krishna to guide her amidst this tough situation. Later, Krishna meets his family for the last time and puts forth a request.

videos.title: Krishna Bids Goodbye
videos.overview: Before leaving Dwarka, Krishna has Rukmini revisit their beautiful times. Later, he tells Balaram of his departure, and they begin to weep uncontrollably.

videos.title: Krishna Breathes His Last
videos.overview: Jara shoots an arrow towards Krishna's foot that injures him mortally, and he passes away. With Krishna's death, Kali Yug begins with a cataclysm on earth.
